The lifeguards are alarmed when they spot an aggressive beachgoer wielding a knife. They decide to take the beach buggy to chase him down.

Tommy showcases the art of rescue in the funniest moment of the season. An unmanned boat drifts off Bondi. Troy rescues a young girl in front of the tower with her dad unaware of the dilemma. Glick takes Kerrbox, who is afraid of heights, up in a helicopter.
Chappo is conflicted when he nabs a young bag snatcher. Whippet and Reidy treat a woman found face down and unconscious in the water. And a skateboarder dislocates his ankle in the skate bowl.

Harry loses his temper with three swimmers he warned not to swim in a dangerous area, leading to trouble with boss Hoppo, who decides to test lifeguards' customer service skills with a secret "mystery shopper" on the beach. Comedian and actor Rob Shehadie plays an annoying wannabe lifeguard - Steve.

As the season concludes, lifeguards play a final prank on trainee Harrison, enlisting football star Alessandro Del Piero to break the 'no ball games' rule. Nicola faces her fear of open water when a boat sinks off Bondi. Lifeguards build unique boats for their annual wave-riding contest.

On New Year's Day thousands descend on the beach, lifeguards deal with drunk people including one who really doesn't want to get out of the water. When Harries is alerted to a baby not breathing in the car park, he is faced with the biggest challenge of his 28-year career.

Lifeguard Maxi juggles lifeguarding and firefighting duties. An Iranian tourist is pulled ashore unresponsive and they battle the language barrier as they try to assess if it's a spinal, drowning, or head injury. Harries comes against his own language barrier with the rescue of an Irish tourist.

Rookie Lifeguard, Julie from Newcastle, visits Bondi to learn the ropes on Australia's busiest beach. She's never done a rescue before and hopes this could be her day. And a fight breaks out when a man confronts a photographer taking pictures of his topless girlfriend.

Newbie Max paddles 600 metres to reach a lone swimmer treading water near shark nets. Lifeguards attend to skate park injuries, and newbie Tyson tests his skate skills with a pro. Lifeguards Jackson and John both attend to a woman struggling in the surf.

Huge waves hit Bondi, leading Bisho to perform a cliff-face rescue with just flippers and a rescue tube. Trainee Taco faces consequences for rookie errors but earns redemption with the rescue of the season as a woman is caught beyond the waves in enormous surf.

Chappo must decide which of three struggling swimmers to rescue first. Lifeguards use spotlights when Bondi hosts 15,010 World Pride Beach Party revellers. Hoppo celebrates his 30th year on the beach.

Backpackers trade snowflakes for sunscreen as they flock to Bondi for Christmas. The Hare Krishnas make an appearance, both on land and in the rips. Maxi plays a Christmas prank on his cousin Ryan, and Nicola receives news of a scuba diver drowning off Bondi's northern headland, Ben Buckler.

Harries attempts to play matchmaker for Singlets. Harries, Max, and Singlets conduct a mass rescue, saving seven people caught in two separate rips. Harrison and Harries encounter a phone thief. A missing dad is reported on the beach.

The new season at Bondi introduces fresh faces with trainee Ryan, Maxi's cousin, who struggles with the megaphone. New recruit Chris from Western Australia faces a life-and-death situation. Mario tackles his first mass rescue on the jet ski. Young Jethro hits it off with a pair of drag queens.

programmes.t: Stung by the Longest Stinger! (Cow Killer Ant)

Beaded lizard vs. Gila monster. Coyote compares these venomous reptiles in a desert showdown, highlighting their bite strength and venom use.One of the world's most dangerous stings comes from the killer bee. Coyote gets stung and breaks down their behavior and threat level.

Mark enters a twisting maze filled with cactus spines. One wrong move means pain, so he's got to think fast—and duck low.This spider might bite—but will it? Coyote examines the risk and anatomy of a feared species in this myth-busting episode.

programmes.t: Did I Catch the Deadliest Snake in America?
programmes.d: Coyote may have caught the deadliest snake in the U.S. He examines its venom, behavior, and what makes it so feared among experts.Handling a black widow spider sounds insane, but Coyote does it to test bite behavior and safety protocols. Proceed with caution!

Leeches attack in this jungle trek! Mark shows how tiger leeches feed and what it takes to remove them once they latch on.In the aftermath of wildfires, koalas need help. Coyote joins a rescue team in Australia to treat, care for, and rehome injured marsupials.

programmes.t: Stung by a Stonefish! (Rare Freshwater Version)
programmes.d: A rare freshwater stonefish delivers one of the most painful stings Mark has ever endured. It's both risky and riveting.The thorny devil lizard is covered in spikes and full of surprises. Mark explores its desert defenses and water-collecting superpowers.

programmes.t: Baby Komodo Encounter – Are They Dangerous?!
programmes.d: Baby Komodo dragons may be small, but they pack serious attitude. Coyote gets up close to answer the question: are they dangerous?A wobbegong shark hiding in a tide pool? Mark finds this camouflaged predator and explains its hunting style and unique appearance.

programmes.t: Don't Try This with a Devil!
programmes.d: Nicknamed “the devil,” this creature is covered in barbs and bad attitude. Coyote investigates what makes it so infamous.The bulldog ant is aggressive, fast, and loaded with venom. Mark takes on its painful sting and breaks down what makes this ant so deadly.

Bright, beautiful, and deadly—the blue ring octopus carries venom strong enough to kill. Mark gets close to show what to look out for.A simple photo turns into a full-on wilderness blooper reel. Mark's attempt at the perfect selfie gets out of hand—literally.

Discover the brilliant world of biodiversity in this natural history documentary. From the scorching sand dunes of Namibia, to the tropical Tasmanian rainforest, to the bitter waters of the Baltic Sea, this film visits the most extraordinary ecosystems and the creatures that inhabit them. We also learn how human activity has forced species into extinction and reflect on the importance of preserving diverse environments.

programmes.t: Giant Sea Serpent: Meet the Myth

Battling weather and wary game in mountainous terrain, he uses his spot-and-stalk hunting skills to discover Kiwi red stags are a trophy worthy of the wall and the cook pot.

programmes.d: Steven Rinella and local pig hunting expert, Darren Moore, spend a wild, action-packed day tracking down Captain Cook boars in the thick New Zealand bush. Their tools for the job include two tough little pig dogs, a knife, and some real grit. Wild pigs are dangerous critters and this is as visceral as a hunt gets. Along the way, Steve learns a new technique for field-prepping whole hogs.

But with hard work, Steve experiences a do-it-yourself high country hunt like no other.

Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

Ever since his father died, young Kale (Shia LaBeouf) has become increasingly sullen and withdrawn, until he finds himself under house arrest. With cabin fever setting in, he turns his attention to spying on his neighbors, becoming increasingly suspicious that one of them is a serial killer. However, he wonders if he is right, or if his overactive imagination is getting the better of him.

After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.

Factory worker Trevor Reznik (Christian Bale) suffers from insomnia so severe that his condition has taken its toll on his weight and his mental health. When Trevor unintentionally causes an on-the-job accident that horribly injures a coworker (Michael Ironside), he begins to become even more troubled. Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian).

The chairman asks Inhyuk what is needed to establish a trauma center, leaving Inhyuk torn over whether to bring the highly skilled Euna onto the team. Meanwhile, Inhyuk, Jaein, and Minwoo face a harrowing dilemma: deciding who to operate on first—a kidnapper who knows the child's whereabouts, or an injured detective.

Confronted once again with moments of solitude and choice at the patient's bedside, Minwoo and Jaein are forced to reflect on what it truly means to face a life alone. Meanwhile, a patient with a shattered pelvis is rushed in, and Seongjin—who has fellowship experience in pelvic surgery—comes down from Orthopedics, only to hesitate over whether to proceed with the operation.

During a dinner together, Inhyuk offers his congratulations to Euna and her fiancé, but an unmistakable tension lingers between the two men. Meanwhile, the ER is flooded with patients stung by jellyfish after a seaside outing—only to be thrown into further chaos when three men and women arrive with shotgun wounds.

As Minwoo and Jaein clash over opposing views on amputating Wonguk's leg, the announcement of support for a new trauma center further clouds the decision on whether to proceed with surgery. Meanwhile, Minwoo struggles to understand Jaein's unusually sympathetic approach toward the kidnapper Yoo Seung-cheol.

Though Wonguk's leg amputation is successfully completed and the team breathes a collective sigh of relief, Minwoo is left conflicted as he gazes at the severed limb. Watching Euna hand over her duties and prepare to leave for Canada, Inhyuk is overcome with memories from the past.

When Daeje, suffering from severe headaches and unable to even stand, is rushed into the ER, tension grips the hospital. Unaware that Jaein is Daeje's granddaughter, Minwoo stays by her side, watching over a visibly shaken and distraught Jaein.

The hospital staff soon learns the shocking truth—that Jaein is the chairman's granddaughter. At the same time, an emergency audit is launched by the Ministry of Health and Welfare. With Daeje still unconscious, calls rise to convene a board meeting to determine who will lead the hospital in his absence, leaving Geumnyeo deep in deliberation.

To save Slugterra and the Elemental Slugs reaches its climax as the Shane Gang face a final showdown.

To master the mysterious slug-slinging art of Slug Fu, Eli must train alone with Junjie. That means leaving behind the rest of the Shane Gang-as well as all of Eli's slugs, and the ultra-powerful Elementals! Pronto vows to keep the Elementals safe, but proves so annoying that they run-er, hop-away!
As Kord, Trixie and Pronto struggle to keep the wily Elemental Slugs out of the wrong hands, Eli and Junjie's Slug Fu training is cut short by a madman.

programmes.st: The Journey to the Eastern Caverns
programmes.d: Eli and the Gang find a way to take Junjie back home to the Eastern Caverns-and find a whole bunch of trouble waiting for them when they get there!

Upon returning to the Outlaws' jungle camp, the Shane Gang suffer a sneak attack from the Emperor's Underlord Holt, who steals almost all of their slugs and loads them onto the Dragon Train for transport to the Emperor. With precious few slugs to use as ammo, the Shane Gang must be extra resourceful to get them back.
In order to reach the Emperor of the Eastern Caverns, Eli and Junjie pose as Underlords to enter the Tournament of Underlords.
In a climactic battle, Junjie and Eli confront the Emperor and the Dai-Fu as the fate of the entire Eastern Caverns hangs in the balance!

While Junjie struggles with the knowledge of what he did during his time as the Dark Slinger, the Shane Gang meet a former servant of the Emperor who wants to turn over a new leaf. But can the Shane Gang help a bad guy learn to do good?

When the Shane Gang arrive at a cavern overrun by thieves terrorizing the good townfolk, they decide to use Pronto as bait, hoping the thieves will eliminate each other as each strives to be the first to capture the valuable molenoid-the only one the Eastern Caverns have ever seen. However, their plan goes awry when Underlord Holt arrives and commands the thieves to work together to bring him Pronto-dead or alive!

When the Shane Gang travel to the Auroris Mine, they discover a legendary monster carved out of stone attacking the mines-the Pyritor. Trixie studies the legend to help them locate the creature's home and put a stop to its reign of terror, but first they must confront the true nature of the beast, and its assistant!

Determined to up his game against Stone Warriors, Kord visits a famous Eastern Technician for help creating a new blaster upgrade. Building the new upgrade is difficult...but working with the Technician is practically impossible!

A winter-time holiday has arisen in the Eastern Caverns around the mysterious "Giver," who makes an annual visit to deliver slugs to the people of the East. But when a group of thieves make off with the Giver's precious cargo of slugs, our heroes must ride to the rescue-and discover the secret of who the Giver really is.

programmes.d: Junjie recounts the ancient history of the Eastern Caverns and his ancestors, and the events that led to his downfall and transformation from the Eastern Champion to the Dark Slinger.
When Pronto accidentally uses the Emperor's sword blaster, he can suddenly do no wrong. Lady Dai-Fu manipulates Underlord Holt into trapping the Shane Gang with a new superweapon: the Iron Warrior!

Inspired on the composer's unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programmes.st: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programmes.d: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

When young Fool (Brandon Adams) breaks into the home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he discovers a disturbing scenario where incestuous adult siblings have mutilated a number of boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs in their large, creepy house. As Fool attempts to flee before the psychopaths can catch him, he meets their daughter, Alice (A.J. Langer), who has been spared any extreme discipline by her deranged parents. Can Fool and Alice escape before it's too late?

Talented Christine (Susanna Foster) is unaware that her singing lessons are being funded by a secret admirer, Enrique (Claude Rains), a mysterious violinist with a disfigured face. Christine's colleagues become suspicious when mysterious accidents start occurring at the Paris Opera House, as the deaths coincide with her meteoric rise to stardom. Christine's suitors, Raoul (Edgar Barrier) and Anatole (Nelson Eddy), brave the dark recesses of the opera house to find the true culprit.

Composer Lord Ambrose D'Arcy (Michael Gough) and his backer, Harry Hunter (Edward De Souza), struggle to find a replacement for the female lead in their new opera after she quits in the wake of a gruesome murder. When a new prospect, the nubile Christine Charles (Heather Sears), disappears, Harry cautiously investigates. Meanwhile, a mysterious masked man (Herbert Lom) who is eerily familiar with the opera holds Christine captive and offers to groom her to play the part.

When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

When Chuckie discovers that Kimi is upset, he gets the gang to help him redesign her room. It turns out that she is homesick for Japan and misses her biological father.
When the gang looks for Halloween costumes in the Finster's basement, they find TP+KF carved on the wall. Chuckie is furious that Tommy might like Kimi and their friendship is put to the test.
When the comic book starring Chuckie's favorite superhero gets canceled, he is too depressed to help Tommy with his science fair project. The gang tries to find Chuckie a new hero to worship.

programmes.st: What's Love Got to Do With It?
programmes.d: Angelica falls in love with a handsome sub teacher. She tries to date him by failing her assignments. Meanwhile, Tommy, Phil, and Chuckie are part of the tennis club run by Pangborn and Chuckie is afraid to shower in the locker room.

Rachel moves to another town and fearing the worst, Tommy braces for a long mourning period. This is cut short when he meets Anita. When Rachel turns up unexpectedly, Tommy finds himself between a rock and a hard place.
Kimi heads a petition to ban cell phones in school, but Angelica drives a wedge between the siblings by hoodwinking Chuckie into helping her petition against the ban.
When the gang's parents feel that they are spending too much time watching TV, they ban it from the house. How will the gang get by without their favorite programs?

The guys want to go camping, but Gustavo nixes the idea because it’s dangerous. Instead they use their connections to camp on a sound stage, but things go awry as the guys try to show off their roughing it skills.

Kendall and Logan volunteer at a dog shelter and end up adopting 12 dogs, but a sneaky heath inspector is on to them. Carlos and Jennifer’s puppy love is sickening and it’s up to James and the other Jennifers to rescue them.

Kendall buys Jo a gold necklace to show that he’s committed, but Camille thinks Logan bought it for her. Gustavo hangs BTR’s new gold record and Carlos and James wonder what would happen if they played it.

The guys accidentally destroy the tape of the new Big Time Rush episode they were supposed to give the network. Needing a replacement episode the guys decide to make a blooper show which Stephen Glickman and Ciara Bravo host.

Big Time Invasion: BTR has to stop the invasion of the British boy band! Concerned that Gustavo is spread too thin, the boys try to hire a top music manager. Unable to agree, the four split and a rift quickly escalates within the band.

Lucy releases her revenge album about Kendall and it becomes a huge hit! James, desperate for attention, creates a rumor that he and Cher Lloyd are recording a duet, and Carlos gets bad press after he appears to hit an old lady.

The guys are caught in a web of lies. Kendall has to keep Jo from discovering Lucy has returned to the Palm Woods. Logan’s fib about being sick turns into a medical emergency and Carlos and James claim Rocque Records was robbed.
A six-year-old argument between Drake and Josh is suddenly rekindled when their conflicting accounts of a incident at a San Diego Padres game finds them each placing the blame on the other.
Drake's new girlfriend might be tougher than him.  Josh trying to impress Mindy's parents might be even tougher.  Will the boys prevail, or will girl power rule the day?
When Drake and Josh find out Megan have adopted a pet sheep, they want nothing to do with it.
Josh gets a student teaching job in Miranda's classroom, and Drake potentially discovers his new drummer.
Drake gets in trouble at school and is assigned to mentor a young boy.  But when Drake's new "little sibling" likes Josh more than Drake, we discover that brotherly love hurts.
When a crime show decides to film reenactments at the Premiere, fantasy and reality collide as Josh uproariously finds himself cast as the lead.  San Diego's most wanted Movie Bandit!

True is stunned to find some of her designs in Mad Style's Reject Room of bad ideas, and takes out her anger on Max. True, Lulu, and Ryan help Amanda get revenge on an artist ex-boyfriend by inadvertently destroying his exhibit.

When asked to give a speech to a large group of Max's designer colleagues True is forced to conquer her fear of public speaking. Meanwhile, Ryan and Lulu are convinced Mad Style's new male model from Transylvania is a vampire.
After Ryan breaks the air conditioner on the hottest day of the year, True and her friends discover Mad Style's arctic room.
True becomes jealous of the cute girl who replaces Hank after he retires. Meanwhile, Ryan is a finalist to get into the Junior Magicians Club.

There's a big comic book convention in town and Kenan and Kel are dying to go.  Too bad Kenan has to train Rigby's new employee, Sharla, that day.  The guys decide to go anyway and things go downhill from there.
Kenan and Kel manage to score dates with two lovely young ladies, but they end up with their heads stuck in a fence.
The Rockmores get a brand new television set.  Kel breaks the new TV that Chris was planning on raffling off at Rigby's, so Kenan pulls the old switcheroo.

Hailed as a landmark film that dazzles with deep emotion and exceptional acting, PHILADELPHIA stars Tom Hanks and Denzel Washington as two competing lawyers who join forces to sue a prestigious law firm for AIDS discrimination. Rating: PG-13

Libby Parsons discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.
AMISTAD is about a 1839 mutiny onboard a slave ship that is traveling towards the Northeast Coast of America. Much of the story involves a court-room drama about the slave who led the revolt.
Old ways die hard. It's the lesson learned by Carl Lee Hailey, a Mississippi factory worker, when two racist thugs brutally assault his ten-year-old daughter on a drunken spree.

Academy Award winners Julia Roberts and Denzel Washington star in this thriller about a young law student whose theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a web of greed, corruption, and murder.

Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.
Multiple Academy Award winner Tom Hanks reunites with his Sleepless in Seattle co-star, Meg Ryan, and director Nora Ephron, to discover love at first byte in this online romantic comedy.

Dylan ends up on Seefra, where the superstitious population has no technology. Rhade is there, none too happy to see Dylan.
Beka is dumped on Seefra after the Andromeda is stolen, and Dylan must prove the ship is his.
Still, on Seefra, Dylan finds Harper, who has adjusted to life there, and the mysterious Doyle.
It turns out Doyle is an android, built by Harper to contain Rommie's core programming. During a battle with androids from the future, a way out of Seefra is destroyed.
Beka wins a prize from a radio DJ, learns the truth about Seefra, and locates the Meethus Diagram - but has no idea what it does.
A scientist from the original Commonwealth shows up, caught in a time loop.
Flavin returns, sparking a gang war, and helps Dylan develop as a Paradine.
A crystal that can restore the Andromeda's power is discovered, but in order to get it, Dylan must work for the mine's owner - who uses slave labor.
Tunnels are discovered on Seefra which can be used to reach eight other Seefra planets.
When an old man is killed, Beka, Rhade, and Harper are the main suspects and stand trial.
Rhade leads the rebels in a battle against a warlord on Seefra-5. A scientist previously thought dead helps Harper rebuild the quantum teleporter.
Dylan discovers that Beka's boyfriend was really Drago Musevini, and he used Beka's DNA to create the Nietzscheans. She is their Alpha Matriarch.
Beka and Rhade find a test that will either grant them great wealth or drive them to madness.
Harper discovers a program built into the Seefra system that can destroy eight of the planets, likely as a defense mechanism. Trance tries to stop this.
While Harper works on a way to save the Seefra system, a spy sneaks aboard Andromeda and attacks Beka.

programmes.st: Saving Light From a Black Sun
programmes.d: An attempt is made to fix the blinking sun of Seefra, but Trance is replaced by a doppelganger.
When Dylan is badly injured in a lab explosion, he travels through a series of alternate realities.
Polnareff revives his sister Shelly using one of his three wishes but is then attacked by her. The enemy Stand user, Cameo, then says he'll grant Polnareff's last wish and revives Avdol.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The High Priestess, Part 1
programmes.d: Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine as a new means of transport, but as they travel through the Red Sea they realize that there are few places to escape to should danger arise underwater.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The High Priestess, Part 2
programmes.d: The team attempts to escape the submarine with scuba gear as it sinks under attacks from the shape-changing enemy Stand "High Priestess."

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 1
programmes.st: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 1
programmes.d: Jotaro and his friends finally land in Egypt, where DIO awaits, and are cutting through the desert when a helicopter approaches. The helicopter belongs to the Speedwagon Foundation and is there to make a special delivery requested by Joseph.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 2
programmes.st: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 2
programmes.d: Jotaro and crew acquire the help of Iggy but are ambushed by a water Stand. With Kakyoin injured, Avdol tries out a stratagem which the unseen enemy quickly sees through. Meanwhile, Iggy is napping.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Khnum's Zenyatta and Thoth's Mondatta
programmes.d: After the battle with N'doul, Kakyoin and Avdol are badly hurt, so the group heads for a hospital in Aswan. Unfortunately, dangerous enemies could be all around them even there.

A young man named Chaka finds a mysterious sword on the beach. Though other men try, Chaka is the only one who can draw it. The sword claims Chaka as its master and sends the youth in pursuit of Jotaro and his friends with deadly intent.

Having defeated the "Anubis" Stand user Chaka, Polnareff pays a visit to a barber. But when the barber starts attacking him with Chaka's sword, the Frenchman realizes the sword itself is the Stand user.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bast's Mariah, Part 1
programmes.d: On the way to Luxor, Joseph notices an electrical outlet set in a rock. Fascinated by the rare sight, Joseph goes in for a closer look and gets shocked. Though he seems fine afterward, soon all manner of small accidents begin to occur around him.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bast's Mariah, Part 2
programmes.d: Due to the powers of an enemy Stand, Joseph's body becomes magnetized. While chasing after the woman he suspects is the Stand user, Joseph learns that Avdol has also become magnetized from touching a different electrical outlet.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Set's Alessi, Part 1
programmes.d: With Joseph and Avdol busy fighting Mariah, Jotaro and Polnareff get concerned about why they haven't shown up yet. As the two search Luxor, Polnareff senses someone following them and confronts the man.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Set's Alessi, Part 2
programmes.d: The power of Alessi's Stand "Set" has turned Polnareff back into a child, leaving him confused and alone. A passerby named Marena takes the boy into her home to help him, but they are followed by Alessi and his terrible powers.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Gambler, Part 1
programmes.d: After a long journey, Jotaro and his friends finally reach Cairo. They begin asking about the location of DIO's palace and find one man who says he has information, but will only answer if the group can beat him in a game.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Gambler, Part 2
programmes.d: After losing to D'Arby, Joseph and Polnareff have their souls taken. In order to have their souls returned, Jotaro shows off Star Platinum's powers before beginning a match with D'Arby, warning him that cheating won't work.

The Super Fight tournament kicks off while Genos takes on multiple monsters who have appeared in City C.

Goketsu, the first Super Fight Tournament champion, arrives in the stadium. He’s aiming to force the competitors to turn into monsters themselves.
Yuki, driven by her desire to stop hurting Zero, tries to regain her memory of the past and becomes haunted by even more powerful visions.
Yuki is continually haunted by visions of blood. Nevertheless, she is determined to find out about her past from Kaname, but he repeatedly evades her question.
Kaname asks Yuki to be his lover. The Night Class guards begin accompanying her everywhere, and Yuki cannot hide her embarrassment. Why does Kaname go to such great lengths to protect Yuki?
Senri returns to the Academy, but upon having a confidential talk with Ichiru, he becomes noticeably different from before.
Light, his memory recovered, orders Misa to begin killing after Higuchi dies.
Light has removed everyone in his way and is closer to achieving his perfect world.
A new investigator steps forward, Near, a central figure in the SPK, an organization that is trying to catch Kira without relying on L.
Light, acting as L, reveals to Near that his sister Sayu has been kidnapped by someone wanting to trade her for the Death Note.
Light tries to discover where Mello and his Mafia associates are hiding and uses Misa's eyes to find the Death Note's current owner.
Mello busts into SPK headquarters to retrieve a photograph of himself to make sure he won't be killed by Kira.

The girls encounter a couple named Mitsuo and Yukiko who are searching for their missing daughter Miku.
Vice Principal Mishima learns from the rescued Tanizaki about a man known as the Delivery Man believed to be their leader.
The Coppelion succeed in bringing down the monster crow, which then crash-lands in one of the Zones.

programmes.st: Tim Medhurst and Izzie Balmer, Day 3
programmes.d: Izzie Balmer and Tim Medhurst search for antiques to sell at auction in Wales. Izzie finds an ornament from the WWI trenches and Tim discovers some chocolate that's 100 years old.

programmes.st: Tim Medhurst and Izzie Balmer, Day 4
programmes.d: Antiques experts Izzie Balmer and Tim Medhurst hope to make big profits when they sell their wares in Wales. Izzie finds her way to some maps and Tim's made up about a medal.

programmes.st: Tim Medhurst and Izzie Balmer, Day 5
programmes.d: It's crunch time in Wales for our antiques experts. At the final auction, Izzie Balmer pins her hopes on two auspicious vases while Tim Medhurst hopes that his letter box delivers.

programmes.st: Irita Marriott and James Braxton, Day 1
programmes.d: James Braxton and Irita Marriott cruise through Kent in a classic car. James spots a child's rattle that sparks international interest, while Irita's hopes rest on a damaged lamp.

programmes.st: Irita Marriott and James Braxton, Day 2
programmes.d: James Braxton and Irita Marriott shop along England's south coast. James buys high value items with his wedge of cash, but Irita makes some canny purchases in a bid to close the gap.

programmes.st: Irita Marriott and James Braxton, Day 3
programmes.d: An old beer bottle and a fish kettle whet James's appetite for profits in East Sussex and Hampshire, while Irita hopes a 19th century puzzle box solves her auction woes.

programmes.st: Irita Marriott and James Braxton, Day 4
programmes.d: Antiquers James Braxton and Irita Marriott rummage around the antique shops of Wiltshire and Dorset. Will porcelain or brass bring the experts riches at auction?

Frank goes toe to toe with an investigative journalist who refuses to give up her source, despite the source admitting to committing murder.
When a suspect voluntarily admits to killing a reality show celebrity chef in his own restaurant, Danny and Baez are convinced the suspect is taking the fall for someone.

When an assassination of someone close to Frank transpires, Frank orders all hands on deck to catch the killer. Working the case, Danny and Baez go see Mario Hunt ('Method Man'), a well-known member of a deadly gang.
When a member of the Reagan clan is shot, Danny tries to track down the gang member responsible, without letting his emotions get the best of him.
Frank goes on high alert when a threat to New York City may be imminent following a terrorist attack in the Middle East, on the sixth season premiere of BLUE BLOODS.
Danny and Baez investigate a possible serial killer who sends a chilling message to Danny, and Erin toys with the idea of applying for a judgeship.

programmes.st: All the News That’s Fit To Click
programmes.d: When newspaper reporter Lorenzo Colt (Zachary Booth) is targeted while wearing NYPD gear on a ride-along with Jamie and Eddie, Frank puts Danny and Baez on the hunt for the shooter who may be out for other members on the force.
Erin’s attempt to convict a slippery mob boss for an old murder is muddled when her former informant, Vincent (Dan Hedaya), leaves witness protection to provide his old boss with an alibi.

Danny joins the hunt for two escaped convicts after hearing one of them is someone he helped to wrongfully imprison. Also, Gormley criticizes a plan from Trey Delgado (Esai Morales), an NYPD sergeant who Gormley thinks is having an affair with his wife.
When Jamie is caught on camera committing what could be construed as police brutality at an anti-policy demonstration, Frank is forced to turn the case over to Internal Affairs.
Danny and Baez investigate the theft of the famous car that was driven in a classic film, now owned by Owen Cairo (Anthony Edwards).

When Danny and his family are threatened by Thomas Wilder (Louis Cancelmi), a serial killer Danny has been unable to apprehend, Linda’s concern intensifies over her husband’s job as well as the state of their marriage.

When a homicide case ends in a hung jury, Erin is forced to take over the case from her colleague, ADA Kelly Blake (Diane Neal), and with the help of DA investigator Anthony Abetemarco (Steve Schirripa), find a missing witness.
Adam tries to find the good in Howard Mead, a talented troubadour who refuses to stay on the right side of the law.
When a Italian immigrant comes to the Ponderosa, he decides he wants to give up the guitar to become a cowboy.
Joe becomes fascinated by detective literature and drags Hoss into the picture when he suspects the bank is going to be robbed.
With a storm brewing, Adam takes refuge at a way station, run by cantankerous Jesse and his young grandaughter Marty, who yearns to see what exists away from the way station.
The Pony Express sets up office in Virginia and Joe is one of the first to join up.  Ben also decides to invest in the fledgling enterprise.
Conclusion to the previous-week's episode, where the Cartwrights provide needed assistance to the Pony Express.
Young, adoring Wendy Daniels has come to Virginia City to meet up with her father, Taylor Daniels, who has been traveling on business for the last five years.
Joshua Norton, an eccentric and formerly wealthy San Francisco merchant who considers himself Emperor of the United States and Protector of Mexico, comes to the Ponderosa.
In what is arguably the best comedy of the series, Hoss swears he has seen green elves running around the Ponderosa and a smooth-talking Irishman complicates matters even worse.
Billy Horne is a white man who was captured by the Shoshone when he was six. He comes into Ben & Joe's campsite one night uninvited.

Little Joe convinces Ben to hire Harry Starr, a half-Indian who is accused by other ranchers of being a chronic horse thief. Joe sets out to prove the others wrong, but is the youngest Cartwright's trust misplaced?

Clay Stafford signs on to work for the Cartwrights and shortly afterwards shoots and kills a man who accuses him of cheating at poker.  The miners warn Clay to leave town, but it appears he killed in self-defense.
When Joe and his friend Mitch go after a puma, Joe climbs a big peak and throws his gun up higher, intending to crawl up after it.
Adam encounters drunken artist James Callan, branded a "squaw man" because he is married to an Indian, and whose talent is going to waste in the town of Sheep Head.
Ben finds an old journal that he kept while in a wagon train travelling from St. Joseph, Missouri to Ash Hollow.

Hoss' latest acquaintance, an Englishman named Professor Poppy, is actually Percival Alexander Mundy, M.D., who has given up the practice of medicine.  However, when Hoss is shot in the back, only Mundy's skill can save his life.
Hoss develops amnesia after being bushwhacked and hit over the head by two outlaws and moves in with a Dutch couple.
Kawaki and Himawari’s class goes on a field trip to an uninhabited island.
The assassin targeting Kae’s life has finally been revealed.
Kae has been taken away and Kawaki must face a dangerous assassin.
Boruto accompanies Sasuke to a hawk trainer to obtain a messenger hawk.
Tsuzura’s hawk has been sold, and Boruto rushes back to help.
Boruto dozes off on Thunder Train and wakes up in an unfamiliar location.
As test subjects drop off one by one, Boruto tries to find a way to get everyone out alive.
Ouga begins a new experiment and everyone's lives are in danger once again.
Boruto is shocked to discover the identity of someone who may be working for Ouga.
Boruto takes on the person who may be working for Ouga.
Boruto reawakens to find he’s back where he first found himself.
Naruto falls ill, and Sasuke goes to the Tatar Observatory to try to find a cure.
Sasuke is attacked by Meno, the guardian of the Observatory, and then poisoned.

programmes.st: Sasuke's Story: The Secret in the Cellar
programmes.d: Sasuke searches the cellar of the room belonging to Zansul, the director of the Observatory.

programmes.st: Sasuke's Story: The Sky that Fell to the Earth
programmes.d: Having finally gathered the information they need, Sasuke and Sakura try to obtain the Ultra Particles.
A swarm of dragon-beasts suddenly appears at the Observatory, throwing everything into chaos.
Claw Marks left by Code are discovered just outside of the Leaf Village.
At Boro’s facility, Eida has awakened.
Kawaki worries that he won’t be able to protect Naruto or the village.
Due to the risk that Code might attempt to kill Boruto and Kawaki, guards are assigned to them.
Boruto arrives to help Kawaki defeat Code.
Code takes Shikamaru hostage, and in his desire to settle his grudge, Momoshiki joins him.
Boruto makes a desperate decision to prevent Momoshiki from taking over his consciousness again.
Sasuke appears before Naruto to warn him of impending danger. An inconceivable foe lies in wait as Sasuke, the Five Kage and Boruto, charge into another dimension!
Boruto Uzumaki, the son of the village leader, saves a boy named Denki Kaminarimon, who's being picked on by bullies.
After being suspended for the uproar he caused at the entrance ceremony, Boruto makes his way to the academy for the first time.
After getting caught in a fight between Metal and Shikadai, Boruto notices that Metal's chakra is warped, just like Denki's.

programmes.st: A Ninjutsu Battle of the Sexes!
programmes.d: At the suggestion of Shino Aburame, their homeroom teacher, Boruto and his classmates split off into gendered teams to capture flags placed on the roof.
A mysterious student named Mitsuki has transferred into Boruto's class from Hidden Sound Village.
Boruto, Shikadai and Mitsuki notice their teacher is acting different than he usually does, and Shino suddenly attacks them!

Stone discovers that a murdered woman was involved with both a famous newspaper reporter and his son.
A gang takes Mike Stone hostage after killing a policeman in an attempt to flee from a grocery store robbery. They want to trade Stone in for their leader, Buddy Sims.
When a boy disappears after school, suspicion falls on the neighborhood recluse.

Mannix is hired to look into who's trying to kill a movie studio's popular, but non-believing, arrogant male star.

Three thugs hold Mannix, Peggy, and a woman hostage, claiming they want the $312,000 she has in a briefcase at home, but they may be after something even more valuable.

programmes.st: And the Horse Jumped Over the Moon
programmes.d: The "perfect crime" — a sky-diving sea-air conspiracy for smuggling heroin into Hawaii — has gone undetected by the law until a member of the smuggling ring tries to sell out for a fix.

Trying to use reason rather than force puts McGarrett at odds with a police captain when a deranged ex-Army sergeant shoots a cop and kidnaps a young girl.

One cheap revolver causes mayhem and murder. McGarrett doesn't underestimate the deadly threat of the cheap gun, for he knows that "Saturday Night Specials" are lethal whether pros or amateurs pull the trigger.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night

Mike is set to go down to the blood bank to donate some blood and asks Archie if he would like to donate.

programmes.st: Hitchhike To Murder / In The Care Of A Killer
programmes.d: Police must wait nearly 30 years before advances in DNA technology give them the chance to convict the killer of a young hitchhiker, and Philadelphia police wage a 16-year hunt for the man who raped and killed a 10-year-old girl.

In December 1985, when human bones are discovered in the woods, it puts an end to the search for missing teen David Reed. David's skull fractures point to murder; but it will be decades before investigators can find his killer.
The loving aunt of a close-knit family is stabbed to death in her home. It takes two decades for detectives to discover that a key witness was an imposter--and caused the case to go cold.

The brutal stabbing murder of a Florida woman is solved when police find crucial DNA evidence in spit left on the pavement. And a man is put away for rape and murder when his footprint matches the footprint he left at the crime scene 18 years before.

A killer helps convict himself when he boasts about his crime to prison cellmates; and New Hampshire investigators probing the murder of a pregnant woman found raped, strangled, and dumped into her bathtub, get a new lead.

When 31-year-old real estate appraiser Mike Williams mysteriously vanishes while duck hunting in the Florida swamps in December of 2000, authorities suspect he accidentally drowned. For sixteen years his disappearance remains a mystery.

A North Carolina man looking to clear his conscience gives police the information they need to solve a murder. And Indiana police are baffled by the murder of an 86-year-old woman, found dead in her bedroom.

Surprise, surprise! While investigating the murder of a call-girl, Dr. Sloan is caught in the middle of a vice raid!

Dr. Sloan becomes involved in more than politics when he accepts an invitation to attend an election campaign party. A face in a crowd of well-wishers awakens old memories for Mayor Ridgeway's wife, Lauren, with murderous results.

Always trying to help out a friend, Jack Stewart offers his support when a con-man acquaintance tries to straighten out his life. Instead, Jack's entwined in a mysterious fatal car accident investigation involving a posh health spa.
A tense situation erupts into a hotbed of chaos! While awaiting treatment from Dr. Sloan, convicted criminal John Dunbar unexpectedly jumps his guards and seizes a gun.

A devastating earthquake causes widespread damage and Dr. Sloan's hospital goes on emergency power. After the tremors stop, Mark's friend Martin Garfield is found dead in the ruins of his mansion nearby. Was it the earthquake or murder?
Steve's undercover waterfront surveillance causes city-wide panic. His suspect, a gangland hit man, has suddenly developed the plague!
Posing as a visiting missionary, Dr. Sloan goes undercover at a convent to reveal the location and contents of a most mysterious package - a parcel that brought its owner to a sudden, untimely death.
It's double trouble for Dr. Sloan in this second season premiere. What could be worse than an IRS tax audit?

While confronting board members about embezzled charity funds, chairman Elton Malone mysteriously keels over dead. And, one by one, all of the suspects also wind up murdered--at each other's funerals!

Cesar Millan helps an overly aggressive German shepherd and a timid rat terrier.

Basset hounds sibling rivalry; aggressive dog; possessive poodle-mix.
Cesar helps a disrespectful yellow Lab who causes chaos everywhere she goes and some dogs who are misbehaving at the office.
A French bulldog fails the doggy day-care entrance exam; three Jack Russell terriers fight one another for their owner's attention; a beagle howls incessantly while on walks.
A mail carrier learns to thwart dog attacks; two Pomeranians attack each other when left alone; a Swiss mountain dog is aggressive around food.
Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.
Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.
Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.
Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.
In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.
Abuela tells Dora and Boots about a magical chocolate tree that lived near her house when she was a little girl. Dora and Boots set off into the forest to find it!
El Mago, a mean magician, casts a spell on King Popo and Queen Maria, turning them into mountains so they can never be together. Can our heroes break the spell?
When young Pablo loses his magic flute, a terrible drought hits his family's farm. Dora and Boots find Pablo's flute and hurry off to return it to Pablo on his mountain.
Dora and Boots keep running into friends in need of help. Turns out the other animals are all headed to a big party at the Treehouse. They beg Dora and Boots to come too!
Boots is thrilled to hear about the riddle contest today at the Tall Mountain. Who can solve the silliest riddle?
Uh oh! A big storm cloud is coming. Dora and Boots have to warn all their friends in the forest to get home fast so the big storm cloud doesn't rain on them and get them wet.

Boots can't wait for a super-duper toy fire truck that's coming in the mail. But when the package arrives, the box is empty! Seems the toy fell out and is now sitting far away on top of Snowy Mountain.

The stick, the stick, the magic stick! Dora and Boots find a magic stick, and according to the wise old tree frog, it's up to our two young heroes to go to the top of the highest hill to make the stick do its magic trick.

¡Falta algo! Something's missing! Dora and Boots meet a wizard, El Encantador, who's missing his magic wand! Dora and Boots set off on an educational adventure to find El Encantador's wand so he can do his magic.
Squeaky, squeaky! What's that sound? It's Squeaky, Boots' adorably squeezable new bath toy. But when Boots loses Squeaky, we all have to head to the Gooey Geyser to get him back.
Meet Rojo, the newest, shiniest red fire truck. Rojo invites our heroes along as he goes on his very first rescue mission—to help a kitten who's stuck in a tree.

Who do we ask for help when we don't know which way to go?  The Map! But today the Map gets mistaken for a stick by a goofy bird. The bird flies Map all the way to his nest on top of Tallest Mountain.
It's Mother's Day, and Dora wants to help Papi bake Mamá a special cake. But three key ingredients are missing: bananas, nuts, and chocolate.
Go, go, go, Golden Explorers! Dora and her friends have formed a soccer team and are playing the big dinosaurs. Can Dora kick the ball into the net and score a goal?
¡Feliz Navidad! It's Christmas Eve, and Dora and Boots are going all the way to the North Pole to deliver a present to Santa.
Achoo, achoo! What's that sound? Benny the Bull has the sneezes. It's Doctor Dora to the rescue as she sets off for Benny's barn for a house call.

Yee haw! Cowgirl Dora and Cowboy Boots are riding through the Wild West on Pinto, the Pony Express. They have to deliver a special package of cowboy cookies to Benny the Bull. But they'll have to be on the lookout for Swiper.

Dora and Boots meet León, a friendly lion who wants to join the circus. They pedal on a unicycle, tightrope walk, and skate their way to the Big Top so León can become a circus lion and do all his tricks.
Step right up and join the fiesta! Dora and Boots are trying to win the grand prize—the Big Piñata! They need to collect 10 yellow tickets by playing carnival games and rides.
Nothing can stop Dora and Boots; they will not fail! Their job is to deliver the mail! Dora and Boots are mail carriers, and they need to deliver all the letters, even one to Swiper the Fox!

Map finds a red cape and becomes a superhero for the day. He can jump, he can fly, he can blow clouds away with a single, super breath! He's Super Map! When Dora's mommy calls her home, Dora and Boots need to get home fast.
Dora has tried and tried, but she's never been able to climb all the way across the monkey bars. Dora and Boots set off for Play Park so Dora can give it another try.
C'mon and join the musical parade! Dora and Boots are leading a parade over the Piano Bridge and through the Swinging Gate to free the instruments that were locked up by the evil Señor Shhh!
Dora and her friends are super good at hiding, especially Señor Tucán when he hides in the Rain Forest. If we can find all 8 friends, Señor Tucán promises to introduce us to his new baby toucans.

Finding the animals—that's a good trick! If you see an animal, aim and say, "Click!" Dora the photographer and her assistant, Boots, set off with a new camera to take pictures of wild animals for a photo contest.
Dora and Boots are on the hunt for cascarones—special eggs with confetti and prizes inside.

Dora and Boots are Super Spies on a top-secret mission: they have to stop Swiper from swiping Isa's cupcakes. Spy gadgets—everything from rocket sneakers to a Swiper detector—will help them find their way.
Boots is visiting Dora's classroom when they notice that the school pet, a cute and cuddly hamster named Mimo, is missing from his cage. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to rescue him!
"Happy Birthday to you," plays the Birthday Balloon as it floats by high in the sky. There's going to be a birthday party—but whose birthday is it?
Sam Lindsay, an older independent woman, decides to end her medical treatment and take off into the wilderness.

programmes.d: Colleen and Brian's biological father Ethan returns to town with a new wife, intending to take the children away from Dr. Quinn.

programmes.st: Cooper Vs Quinn, Medicine Woman, Part 2
programmes.d: Colleen and Brian run away to keep their father from taking them away from Dr. Mike and Sully. After they are found, it's discovered Colleen has developed pneumonia. Dr. Mike realizes she has to let them go to save them.
The town puts on a production of Romeo and Juliet. Brian tries to learn what love is so he can write a paper for school.
Dr. Mike convinces Robert E to take a job fixing a train boiler, then finds out it is a dangerous job.
A teenage Belle Star robs the saloon with the Younger brothers and is shot. Dr. Mike takes her home in an effort to show her a real home life, attempting to turn her from her life of crime.
An abrasive Dr. John Porter arrives in town after hearing of the discovery of dinosaur bones.
When Dr. Mike becomes the substitute school teacher, the town gets upset when she teaches the children about evolution.
Dr. Mike and Sully convince Chief Black Kettle that he should move his starving people to a new reservation. Dr. Mike and Sully are both working on wedding presents for each other.
Dr. Mike and Sully have second thoughts about their love for one another as they recall their tumultuous relationship.

While on his way to resign as Indian Agent, Sully discovers Loren badly injured in the wilderness and must battle his own despair in order to save him. Meanwhile, Dr. Mike is worried about Brian, who is consumed with his efforts to build a flying machine.
Dr. Mike and Sully go to Reverend Johnson for an honest discussion regarding their upcoming marriage.
The town of Colorado Springs is preparing for the event of a lifetime, the marriage of Sully and Dr Mike. Unexpected guests include Elizabeth Quinn and Rebecca and Marjorie.
Bolstered by the long-awaited arrival of the railroad, the citizens of Colorado Springs busily prepare for the biggest social event in the town's history, the wedding of Dr. Mike and Sully.
Dr. Mike and Sully return from their honeymoon to begin their new life as man and wife.
Baseball fever strikes Colorado Springs when a barnstorming all-star team comes to town.
Dr. Mike's passion for Sully leads to conflict with Colleen.
Blake learns Krystle pawned her emerald necklace to help out Matthew; Fallon tells Jeff she married him solely for her father's welfare; Steven's former lover, Ted, arrives in Denver.
Steven tells Claudia he spent the night with Ted; Krystle leaves Blake; seeing Ted embrace his son, Blake strikes him; Steven accuses his father of murder.
Blake must stand trial for the murder of Steven's lover; Krystle returns home to be with Blake. Fallon testified in her father's behalf but Steven refutes her statements in court.

On the witness stand, Blake maintains his innocence; Matthew learns of Claudia's affair with Steven; Claudia and daughter Lindsay are involved in an automobile accident; The prosecution calls in a mysterious witness that Blake is surprised to see.
Blake's first wife Alexis testifies that Blake is capable of violence; Matthew takes off with Lindsay; Alexis tells Steven of her love for him; the jury announces they have reached a verdict.
Blake is found guilty; Krystle reunites with her husband; Blake strikes Steven; a pregnant Krystle suffers a fall; Alexis moves onto the Carrington estate.
Krystle orders Alexis from the mansion; Blake instructs his attorney to cut Steven out of his will; Claudia attempts suicide; Alexis tells Steven that he is Blake's only child.
Alexis tells Cecil Colby that Fallon is his daughter; Blake and Steven are urged to reconcile; Dr. Toscanni pulls an unconscious Steven from the pool and rushes him to the hospital.

Steven returns to the mansion to recover from injuries sustained by his fall; Krystle's niece, Sammy Jo, arrives to spend a few weeks with the Carrigtons; Alexis hires a private investigator to delve into Krystle's past.

Nick reveals to his sister that Blake is responsible for the death of their younger brother; Sammy Jo and Steven spend the night together; Alexis shoots at Krystle's horse, causing her to be thrown to the ground and hospitalized.
Krystle loses her baby; Steven and Sammy Jo begin dating, although Steven is in love with Claudia. Fallon continues her affair with Nick, and is jealous to find him visiting Krystle in the hospital.

Fallon learns she is pregnant and tells Jeff she is having an abortion; he agrees to divorce her but only if she bears the child. Krystle remains despondent over the loss of her baby; Claudia takes a job with Denver-Carrington.

Alexis tricks Blake into coming to Rome and further traps him by hiring a gossip photographer to snap suggestive photos of the two; Jeff begs Fallon to cancel her abortion; as Nick confronts Krystle, his consolation gives way to passion.

Nick tells Krystle of his deep feelings for her; Steven and Sammy Jo marry; Fallon cancels her abortion; after the scandal caused by the paparazzi photos of Alexis and Blake, Krystle leaves her husband.
Nick persuades Krystle to leave Blake; Steven and Sammy Jo announce they are married; Blake is attacked by gangsters and blinded when his car is bombed.
Blake remains blinded following the explosion; Nick asks Krystle to divorce her husband and marry him; Blake investigates Nick's past; Alexis is determined to drive Krystle from Denver.

Fallon confesses her love to Nick, but he is interested in Krystle; Blake's attempts to bring gangster Logan Rhinewood before a Crime Committee hearing are thwarted; Sammy Jo tells Alexis she knows her secret; Blake receives an anonymous letter.
Grace is jailed after being arrested for murder; Mitch and Wilson discover they share common interests; Tom is among the witnesses questioned by Hernandez and Campbell; Alec meets with Jimmy's crew.
Grace is hospitalized following a brutal beating; Alec schemes to take over his father's business.
A judge is blackmailed during a high profile mob trial.
A father is killed in a car accident and his infant son mysteriously disappears from the accident.
Jess and Nicole investigate when a busload of people goes missing during a casino tour; the bus disappears on its way from Philadelphia to Atlantic City.
Nick and Jess help Pollock find who murdered his snitch.
A drug lord kidnaps a suburban family involved in the illegal trade.
Nine and King work to take Rigo's music to the next level; Rigo's connections to the street scene continue to weigh on his music and his relationship with Poppy.
Dancers are unable to let go during an erotic dance and Sage demands that they go out in search of their sensuality; things heat up between Dondre and Poppy; Sage and Rigo compete.

Cam learns secrets about his family's past, then must deal with the fallout.
Reggie's father makes a sudden appearance in Atlanta; Cassie meets Chen's parents.
Cam, Reggie and Mary Charles' attempts to reconcile their paternal relationships yield varying results; Cassie and Chen try to enjoy their time in Shanghai.
Cam's visit to Walpole sends him on a wild goose chase into the past; Missy receives a troubling phone call; M-Chuck gives some teenagers a piece of her mind.
M-Chuck has unconventional ideas about closure; Cam sees his father in a new light; Reggie and Trent head north.
Cam and Allison clash with some fans; Reggie advises Missy to think twice about taking on a job; Cassie's podcast deals with a hot topic.
Bishop and Lady Mae preside over Calvary's Fall Revival, and decide to take action against Basie; Both Lady Mae and Grace connect with old friends; Grace confronts Mac's new girlfriend.

Kevin and Charity begin divorce proceedings, but the circumstances are exacerbated when Lady Mae learns the truth about Kevin; Grace and Darius's relationship reaches a stalemate.

Jackie Chan plays a shrewd cop who goes undercover with a team of mercenaries when a man he put away two years before commits a murder. The film features the great Sammo Hung as well as the terrific Tony Leung Ka Fai.

Jackie Chan, Michelle Yeoh, and Maggie Cheung lead an action-packed classic with jaw-dropping stunts, from leaping out a ten-story building onto an airborne helicopter to landing on top of a speeding train.
Extremely silly comedy about a self-indulgent private investigator who winds up on a cruise ship full of rich patrons, gorgeous women, murderous terrorists, and scarce food.

A Special Agent is assigned to protect a wealthy business magnate. However, when the businessman is kidnapped in a daring ambush, he teams up with a seasoned detective to crack the case. But soon he discovers the case isn't that simple.
Thongs and Octopus grow attached to the baby they kidnapped for their landlord, which leads to complications in handing the him over.

Jackie Chan stars in this family action-comedy which centers on a man (Chan) who is called to baby-sit his neighbor's children and winds up having to fight off secret agents after one of the kids inadvertently downloads a secret code.
An old soldier captures a young general after a battle in China and takes him on a long journey to collect a reward.
A misunderstanding leads the town to believe that Frasier is gay.
Frasier competes with Martin over the affections of his childhood babysitter.
Frasier's romantic dry spell has everyone trying to set him up.
Frasier inadvertently eavesdrops on Ronee making a date with another man. Martin takes the news badly, accusing him of spying.

Maris seeks protection from Niles for her violent new boyfriend. Because of Daphne's mood swings, Niles tries to keep his meeting secret, which fails when the boyfriend shows up at a fake baby shower and punches Frasier.
Maris is arrested for the murder of her boyfriend. The press goes wild when they find out that Niles inadvertently loaned her the crossbow that was used as the murder weapon.

Lilith comes to town for a psychiatric conference, and Frasier arranges to meet with her. Before he does so, a colleague of Lilith's sets him up on a blind date with her, not knowing who he really is.
Frasier is jealous of Niles' fame resulting from Maris' murder case.
Martin gets high on a pot-laced brownie; Frederick visits the dark side.
A KACL team competes in a weight-loss marathon with another radio station for a trip to Las Vegas. Niles and Martin nurse an ailing pigeon back to health.

The Cranes are plagued by bizarre nightmares on a trip to the mountains.
Frasier's libido fights a losing battle with his conscience when his (married) ex-wife, children's entertainer Nanny G, comes to town and invites him backstage for a rendezvous.
Frasier accidentally gives Martin a mild heart attack by scaring him dressed as a clown, holding a knife.
Desperate to add some excitement to his life, Frasier does something completely out of character.
Daphne and Niles prepare for their baby's arrival, and Frasier looks for love.
Frasier is taken with Charlotte, but she already has a boyfriend, a handsome man named Frank. To try and get his mind off her, Roz takes him to a singles bar.
Frasier plans elaborate dates to try to win Charlotte away from her boyfriend, but ends up being a third wheel when Frank continually shows up, who is oblivious of his intentions.
A road trip takes Frasier and Charlotte off the beaten path, and a series of misunderstandings turns three job interviews into a comedy of errors.
A terra cotta cheese crock becomes a time capsule for Frasier.
Both personally and professionally, Frasier's life is about to change forever.
Frasier, Niles, Daphne, Martin, and Roz move on to new chapters in their lives.
Psychiatrist Frasier Crane returns to his hometown of Seattle to host a radio talk show, but soon discovers he could use a shrink himself when his disabled father moves in.
Fed up with a lack of privacy at home and at work, Frasier decides it's time for his father to move out.
It's a culinary culture clash when Frasier and Niles join their father for dinner at his favorite restaurant.
After trading barbs with a newspaper columnist, Frasier rises to the challenge of a fist fight.
Frasier buys Martin a telescope as a gift, leading to a long-distance relationship with a woman named Irene.
Frasier is furious when he learns that his newest art purchase is actually a fake.
Frasier faces a personal and professional dilemma when he begins dating the ex-girlfriend of one of his radio show callers.
When Frasier and Niles see their father dining with an old family friend, they conclude that Martin once had an affair with the woman.
When Frasier is lured into doing on-air endorsements, his professional credibility comes under fire.
When Frasier contributes to the rumor mill, he causes Bulldog to lose his job.
When a seemingly healthy colleague dies unexpectedly, Frasier becomes obsessed with his own mortality.
Tommy's earned his diploma and a job at Callahan Auto Parts. However, the family business starts to tank, and now Tommy hits the road with his dad's right-hand man, a smug numbers cruncher.

While Frank and his dad tend to an emergency at the airport, Sue spends a maddening night at the hospital, and Bill takes a beating in the hockey rink.
Frank's pledge to be a better father and husband by one calamity after the next, leading to an epic meltdown at Lamaze class.
