Accusations fly between pregnant masseuse and ex; Judge Judy says plaintiff has "Chutzpah."
Woman thought her ex was the one; she claims things fell apart after she loaned him money.
Door kicked in a birthday bash; man claims he paid friend's bail, but lost the money when she never showed up for court.
Flying can opener injury lands exes in court.
Moms in court over beauty pageant.
Salon turns into a storefront church.
Mother wants her ex to help pay for their daughter's medical bills, but father claims she is a hypochondriac.
Man wants engagement ring back; ex wants crib returned.
Exes fight in court over camcorder and more; woman claims hairdresser turned her hair green!
Former couple argues over trip to Mexico that turned into trouble.
Love triangle results in car wreck; teen wants sneakers back from her crush.
Who owes for teen's failed pregnancy?
Ostrich farmer sues for bird's death; a late night parking lot showdown.
A case involving a jeep, a gun and time behind bars.
Clocked by the bouncer at a cowboy boogie bar?
Woman wants Judge Judy to resolve ownership of a car, two pets, and an intimate video in the divorce with her husband.
Teen girls clash at school.
Judge Judy hashes through estranged couple's accusations against each other.
Woman claims another driver spit on her.
Did someone record over singer's demo tape?; band battles over break-up and missing gear.
Was woman blackmailed over a loan?; unpaid phone bill and slashed tires.
Man skidded out of relationship with the Camaro.
Woman claims ex destroyed her things.
Fast food employee spars with manager; teenager sues over prom limo.
Does salon owner owe unhappy clients a refund after their permanent makeup procedures?; bridesmaid dress disagreement ends friendship.
Insurance claim; pizza-parlor fight.
Renter not happy with Beverly Hills landlord; man claims he put money down for his girlfriend on a camcorder, but she stopped making payments.
Was Manicurist scammed by neighboring business?; performer suing booking agent over casino gig.
Man claims girlfriend left with money and their son; teens tussle at the phone booth.
Who keyed the '66 Mustang?
Hospitalized sister claims theft; family clashes over Chow Chow.
Friends argue over a Jeep won in a raffle; who made all the 900 calls?
Daughter sues parents who raised her daughter.
Love loan gone wrong; Judge Judy schools teen parents on growing up.
Tenant claims her landlord placed a bug in her bedroom; dog owner claims stud failed to perform and wants her fee back.
Would-be groom wants money back; woman denies retaliating against family.
Does Dad owe for son's repo'd truck?; who made the long distance phone calls?
Grandson denies stealing from his grandma.
Man claims he made a ring for his biker buddy and was never paid; pool supply owner sues cue maker.
Woman claims she was assaulted when she told a Hollywood electronic store worker that his film was too expensive.
Man upset his mom was buried in his plot; ex-wives fight over late husband's car.
Child denies pulling dog's ears; woman claims she bailed her friend's boyfriend out of jail twice and hasn't been paid back.

This courtroom series stars former family court judge Judy Sheindlin. Each episode finds Judge Judy presiding over real small-claims cases inside a televised courtroom. Her no-nonsense, wisecracking approach has been unsuccessfully copied by other TV court judges.
Boss denies harassing employee.
Neighbors argue over towed truck.
High School Halloween showdown lands in court; underage drinking ends in a wrecked car.
Couple loaned favorite waiter money; woman crashed boyfriend's motorcycle.
Exes fight over game show prizes; woman accused of throwing ex's stuff to the curb.
Real estate agent denies breaking into woman's home.
Son denies stealing mom's bank card; cop paid for dancer's augmentation surgery, now wants the money back.
Would-be adoptive couple sues after birth mother changed her mind.
Daughter sues late dad's common-law wife over inheritance; man claims ex was leading him on.
Woman claims her ex-boyfriend assaulted her, but he claims it was self-defense.
Landlord denies hosing down woman's living room furniture.
Woman claims man convinced her to move away with him saying he would propose, but never did; man claims ex-girlfriend won't return his possessions, but still sends her love letters.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first proceeding, a woman passes away on Mother's Day leaving her grieving son scrambling to pay for funeral expenses. In the second case, a woman sues her trainer for a personal loan; he claims her lawsuit was premature.
Half sisters wield a broomstick and a knife in violent disputes against each other; both filed restraining orders and sue for damages.
Ex-business partners fight over their snake-breeding venture; retaliatory theft of a lizard is caught on tape.
A man sues his ex-landlord for a false arrest after a heated argument.

The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a young woman sues her ex-lover for damages over an alleged assault. In the next case, a man's foray into the dog-breeding business ends in a 5K lawsuit over a French Bulldog puppy he sold to his tenant.
A woman sues a photographer for using photos from a bartered session to promote his business on social media.
A mechanic is accused of threatening a customer after a fight over truck repairs escalates.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, after discovering 8K in 'forged' checks, a woman sends a series of angry texts which leads a man to file for a restraining order. In the next case, a woman is evicted days after moving in; she sues for return of rent and emotional distress.
Newlyweds sue their wedding planner for the 10k court max alleging their wedding party was ejected from a wedding venue; the planner says they still owe her money.
A struggling mother of three claims her brother and his girlfriend disposed of her possessions without her permission.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a woman asks a friend to buy and install a washer/dryer in her home but refuses to pay him despite her continued use of the appliances. She claims the color wasn't right and that they were damaged. In the second case, when a woman purchases a used car from a friend, she leaves hundreds of toll charges in her wake.
A farm worker must defend against his ex-boss's claims that he owes for a phone, rent and a personal loan.
Ex-roommates fight over a violent assault involving a lockout and an emotional support dog; one man claims he blacked out after a chokehold, another says it was self defense.
After providing a home for her grandchildren while her son was in prison, a woman's relationship with her family falls apart after he and his fiance move in.
A woman is granted a lifetime restraining order against an ex-boyfriend who sues her for thousands in personal belongings he says she never returned.
Brothers clash over funeral expenses for their mother; accusations of defamation ensue.
An American Bully breeder sues a man for the remaining balance on a puppy purchased for his seven-year-old daughter.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first proceeding, an unlicensed, uninsured teenager driver fails to yield and crashes into a vehicle carrying a mother and her toddler; who is at fault? In the next case, two men sue each other for the court maximum after their car-trade agreement falls apart; the fate of a 1947 classic Chrysler Sedan hangs in the balance.

After an apartment fire made her homeless, a woman sues a former friend who offered her a place to stay, for a wrongful eviction and unwanted sexual advances while staying with him. He countersues for damages due to false accusations.
After a fight with his pregnant girlfriend, a man invites a female acquaintance to move in; they clash over a personal loan, car damages and assault.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, two Pit Bulls jump over a fence and maul a neighbor's small dog; the Judge speaks to the responsibility that comes with owning dangerous dog breeds. In the next case, a woman sues a hairstylist claiming money owed for improperly installing a wig and destroying it.
A firearms instructor seeks compensation for a valuable rifle he loaned to an ailing client; the defendant says he sold the weapon after the client passed away to satisfy a debt owed by the deceased.

A fundraising effort via t-shirt sales goes awry when a woman is dissatisfied with sample shirts and asks for a refund from a small business owner; a heated incident and a 5k defamation countersuit follow soon after.
A dog attack on Christmas day divides neighbors who fight over which of their dogs was the aggressor and who is responsible for vet bills.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a man drives 2,000 miles to come to the aid of his son and his son's teen fiancé, then is sued by the couple for alleged theft and unpaid wages. In the next case, a newlywed is sued by her sister-in-law for a trip and for wedding expenses.
While away on vacation in Hawaii, a woman claims her roommate turned in a lease renewal without her permission; the roommate has another story.
Both parties sue for the 10k court max when parents fight with their child over ownership of an 18-wheeler; the Judge throws out the countersuit after a heated exchange.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a couple reunites after 30 years only to be torn apart over personal loans after an ex-girlfriend comes back into the picture. In the second case, both parties sue for the 10k court maximum when the cost of a Wolfdog and alleged loss of income are disputed.
Relative strangers regret signing a lease together when one loses their job and the other decides not to move in.
The owner of a wig business claims that a stylist has been making purchases in someone else's name.

The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. Up first, after a failed attempt to live together and dueling 10K lawsuits, the only thing two sisters agree on is that their relationship is forever damaged. In the second case, a woman sues a close friend for damages to her car he allegedly caused by attempting to temporarily repair the vehicle for her.
After being evicted by her father, a teenager sues him for the return of property she says is worth thousands. He accuses her of smoking pot and of breaking promises to help out around the house.
A man is evicted from his own apartment after a roommate files a restraining order against him; they fight over Covid relief, unpaid rent and alleged fraud.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a man says he is hired by a former high school teammate to make auto-parts deliveries. Their working relationship ends with a claim of unpaid wages. In the second case, a mother of three claims she gave her children's uncle $2700 to buy a truck that never arrived; he claims he delivered the truck to her front door.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first proceeding, a young man decides that his new luxury car needs a clear, protective wrap; his girlfriend provides money for the purchase. She is demanding payback. In the next case, after a lengthy incarceration, a man sues relatives for the return of treasured keepsakes from their family home.
A woman claims a bathroom leak caused extensive water damage after a plumber made a house call; the owner of the plumbing company denies any wrongdoing.
A chihuahua is mauled by a larger dog; neighbors fight over liability and vet bills.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. First, a singer/songwriter sues the owner of a video production company for the money paid for music videos; the producer accuses him of violating their contract. In the next case, a woman sues her brother and sister-in-law for thousands in back rent and for damage to her property; they counter with claims of harassment and invasion of privacy.
A security camera captures the moment a senior citizen is shoved to the ground by a neighbor in an ongoing feud over a public parking spot.
A woman claims she made concerning discoveries on her boyfriend's phone while he was sleeping. Mutual restraining orders, police intervention and alleged emotional distress come into play soon after.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a married couple move into a friends' house with 3 kids and 4 dogs in tow and end up suing them over an eviction and alleged property damage. In the second case, a single mother, running a baby shoe business, says the owner of a children's clothing website agreed to buy her company. They argue over the terms of that sale.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first proceeding, a driver refuses to take responsibility for slamming into a parked car because he says the vehicle was parked illegally. Up next, a motorcyclist is flipped into the air when an uninsured driver fails to yield; each woman claims the other is to blame.
A man claims his landlord illegally entered his apartment and accused his teen son of 'walking too hard'; the police are called to their shared home multiple times to intervene.
After flipping a home for profit, a realtor sues the videographer she hired to document her successful renovation process. He says he never signed on for a year-long job.

The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a man sues his estranged wife's boyfriend for damages after being accused of domestic violence when all he was doing was entering his own home. In the next case, ex-roommates, with two cats each, wage emotional warfare over household chores; a heated exchange leaves a woman claiming she feared for her life.

After a bitter break-up, a woman claims her ex-boyfriend showed inappropriate videos of her to his friends and sent a graphic email to her boss. He says she stranded him at a party and trashed his phone.

The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, dash-cam footage of a moped's dramatic collision with a moving car weighs heavily in the determination as to which driver is at fault. In the next case, a federal employee in recovery claims marijuana was being smoked by her fellow tenants. When she brings this to the attention of her landlord, she claims she was evicted.
In this two-part episode, a young man accuses his former boss of selling alcohol to a minor and of vandalizing his car.
In part two, an employer counters his ex-employees' lawsuit with a 10K claim against them for slander and for filing a false complaint.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, an errant lap dance leads to a heated argument between roommates which escalates into an alleged dog attack and vandalized furniture. In the second case, after receiving a large settlement, a young man invests thousands in his longtime friend's podcast. A case of Covid and differing artistic opinions leave them fighting over equipment.
A musician demands recognition and payment for his creative work on a song; he sues for the 10K court maximum for breach of contract.
An electrical contractor sues for the 10K court maximum for negative online business reviews that he claims hurt his business; he is countersued for 10K for allegedly filing a frivoulous lawsuit.

programmes.t: DUI Slam into House and Covid Cancel
programmes.d: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman is trapped in her home with her terrified dog for hours after an impaired driver crashes through the wall. In the second case, when a destination wedding is cancelled due to COVID, a young woman uses refunded airline vouchers. The bride-to-be says she paid for them, and they should have been returned to her.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a woman is accused of repeatedly backing into a teen's car in her own driveway; her daughter testifies against her. In the 2nd case, a man alleges that at the sight of two growling pit bulls on his front porch, he retreated to the safety of his new car. He says the dogs proceeded to bite and scratch his week-old, luxury vehicle.
A tenant's violation of pool rules leads a property manager to take drastic action. The tenant then sues for an alleged assault, attorney fees and emotional distress.
After the bars close, drinking continues in a park but ends when a flying beer can causes thousands in dental damages to a partygoer. Former high school teammates fight over who is to blame.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, the Judge shares memories of her own childhood dance experience while mediating a payment dispute between a dance studio owner and a single mother. In the second case, a woman says her roommate's boyfriend entered their shared apartment unannounced and with his own key. She claims the voicing of her safety concerns led to her eviction.
A woman claims her former employer accused her of being a drug addict and withheld wages. Her employer countersues for defamation of character.
A failed attempt at living together leaves sisters in a bitter dispute over alleged child neglect, a mysterious call to CPS and police intervention after a lockout.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a Father's Day standoff between a teenager and his girlfriends' stepsister ends with the violent smashing of a car mirror. In the second, a man admits that he was only present during the euthanization of a beloved pet because his ex-girlfriend said she would forgive a debt if he provided emotional support.
A spa owner sues a former employee for the 10k court maximum claiming that the aesthetician broke their non-compete agreement and started working well within the seven-mile radius of her business.

Despite being slapped with a restraining order for threatening his ex son-in-law, a grandfather continues to seek payback from him. An eviction, marital debt and care for his grandchildren come into play.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a high school teacher accuses a student of a hit-and-run; the teen's father is reprimanded for allowing his uninsured teen to drive without a license. In the second case, after a woman's business is shut down by the government due to Covid, ex-roommates accuse each other of taking advantage of the rental relief program.
A landlord's new property comes complete with previous tenants who sue him for child endangerment due to alleged lead poisoning. The landlord countersues when they stop paying rent.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a hair-salon owner helps a friend pay for a luxury vehicle which he proceeds to crash; instead of paying her back, he then buys an expensive electric sports car. In the second case, A man accuses his ex-friend of repossessing his car without just cause and demands payback for the 5K he put into it.
An unlicensed contractor sues for damages after a married couple stops payment on a $4200 check for demolition work. They accuse him of property theft and dispute payment for a tractor rental.

A man accuses his sister of kidnapping his special-needs teenager who was, unbeknownst to him, in need of life-saving, emergency brain surgery. The sister is seeking reimbursement for costs associated with that surgery and return of her nephew’s property.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, years after the death of their mother, sisters fight over the disbursement details of her personal belongings. A woman says she only wants one photo with her mother as a keepsake. In the second case, an independent contractor on disability sues an old friend for an unpaid loan and money allegedly stolen from their joint bank account.

Police body-cam footage captures a woman's admission and regret that her pit bull attacked a neighbor's miniature schnauzer. Her actions after the attack tell a different story when pictures surface that show her off-leash pit bull roaming the neighborhood.
An amateur pilot sues for the 10K court maximum when his plane is allegedly damaged by a certified flight instructor who hit an object on the runway. Damning video evidence comes into play.

programmes.t: One-Wheel Whammy and All Bets Are Off
programmes.d: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a teenager on a one-wheel, electric skateboard plows into the side of a car, flies onto the hood and falls to the ground. Lucky to be alive, he now faces a motorist suing for vehicle damages. In the next case, a single father wins a $36,000 sports gambling payout and gives his ex-roommate 6K to 'hold' for him. She claims it was a gift.

Both parties seek the 10K court maximum when a man's death brings to light the fact that he was never married to his 'wife'. Family members and his estranged 'partner' fight over an allegedly false police report and personal property.

A woman is lured into an ill-conceived 'intervention' at a friend's home by being told she will receive drugs once she gets there. She is sued for breaking a TV in a fit of rage, but countersues for damages caused by the emotional trauma she suffered.

Scrappy the French Bulldog makes an appearance in court when a woman sues her kickboxer exboyfriend for custody of their shared pet. The Judge admonishes them for making a long-term pet decision in a short-term relationship.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, when a plumber sues an employer for filing an allegedly false restraining order, the Judge must decide if an ominous voicemail was cause enough for the complaint. In the second case, long after a relationship ends, dueling text messages help the Judge decipher the facts about a disputed loan between ex-lovers.

In this two-part episode, a man fears for his safety and leaves his home when six men show up to defend his roommate during a heated argument. He returns the next day to find his room has been thoroughly vandalized.
In part two, a woman claims she was framed for vandalism and falsely arrested. She seeks compensation for slashed tires and alleged cyberbullying.
When divorced parents sue each other for the 10k court maximum, a teenager is caught in the middle of a feud over a 'maliciously' towed vehicle and multiple reports to child services.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a man with 4 children by 3 different women is at the center of a fight between two of the mothers. He remains silent while they fight over harassment, alleged gun-brandishing and vandalism. In the 2nd case, a bride only offers $50 to her planner who paid thousands to help make sure her California ranch wedding took place during the pandemic.
A fight breaks out between female veterinary workers and a passionate pet owner in seek of emergency care for his injured cat. He sues for damages after receiving a black eye in the parking lot.
A woman's demand that her 4K security deposit be returned is marred by the fact that she took the doorbell with her when she left.
In this two-part episode, a cosmetics salesman is accused of accosting and holding a woman captive for hours plying her with compliments and free samples.
When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.
Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.
A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.
A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.
When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.
A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy

Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!
When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

Appa and Umma's plans for the future push Appa out of his comfort zone.
Appa reaps the benefits of Umma's accessible parking pass. Janet embraces a new ambition.
A new church member makes Umma feel cast aside; Appa becomes jealous of Janet's journaling.
Appa unknowingly ruins Gerald's baby blanket. Jung invites Kimchee for a weekend in California.
Umma and Appa try to fit in at an upscale tennis court; Shannon helps Omar.

Appa finds marijuana in the house. Shannon throws a staff party that doesn't go as planned.
Appa and Kimchee enjoy an impromptu hangout together; Janet and Umma find an envelope of money.
Appa worries about Umma; Janet uses Jung to boost her reputation; Kimchee thinks about an old flame.
Appa makes a controversial call when umpiring pastor Nina's baseball game; Umma gets a sweater.
Kimchee's plan to impress the higher-ups backfires. Shannon inadvertently insults Umma's cooking.
Umma tries to set up Janet with their new mason. Shannon encourages Jung to give Appa a gift.
Janet and Appa take a first aid course. Umma worries her prayers cause more harm than good.
Jung gives Appa and Umma a business presentation for the store.
Mr. Kim offers a gay discount; Mrs. Kim tries to find a cool, Christian-Korean boyfriend for Janet.
Mr. Kim gets competitive with Janet over who is the better photographer.
Jung draws the wrong kind of attention from his boss when he gives Kimchee a Korean wedgie at work.
Mr. Kim is frustrated with Frank the repairman; Janet's cousin Nayoung visits.
Mr. Chin asks Mr. Kim to be his wingman on a date, which is fine until Mrs. Kim tags along.
Mr. Kim disciplines Janet's professor's kid, with unexpected results for Janet.
Janet takes a Hapkido class but Mr. Kim questions the teacher; Jung runs into an old flame.
Mr. Kim offers the new female pastor some free items, which tests his and Mrs. Kim's relationship.
Are Best Before dates on canned food meaningless? Appa is about to find out.
Janet is sick of working for free.
Mr. Kim fixes a broken toilet for Kimchee; Jung hides out with Shannon.
Mr. Kim's friend discovers a lump on Appa's back and he is reluctant to tell his family.
Mrs. Kim wants the family to sing at their church festival but really wants her son to sing instead.
Jung worries his time to ask Shannon to go on a date is running out.
With a local business award up for grabs, Appa is feeling a little jumpy.
Umma invites Pastor Nina to move in while her apartment is renovated.
When Nayoung visits, a white lie leads to romantic chaos.
Janet urges her dad to step up his romance game during a date night with Umma.
While visiting their future burial plots, Appa and Umma make an unfortunate discovery.
Appa and Umma learn that selling illegal face cream has a downside.
In hopes of claiming a winning lotto ticket, Janet searches for a legal loophole.
Kimchee tries to keep his new girlfriend from meeting Jung. Janet speaks her mind in class.
Janet struggles to keep her parents from learning about her relationship with Raj.
Kim's Convenience gets a noisy new neighbor. Jung becomes smitten with a new co-worker.
Appa inherits his daughter's old smartphone. Umma finds a stray dog in the store.
At a party to celebrate getting his GED, Jung can't ignore his feelings for Shannon.
Appa's got a plan to get a new appliance for less, Jung looks to mend old fences.
Appa tries to convince Umma that he's still attractive; Jung returns to Handy.
Appa and Umma take their bickering to a new level. Janet crosses paths with a photography idol.
Appa has a solution for spotty Wi-Fi: use the neighbor's. Jung has eyes for Shannon's friend.
Appa becomes the star of Gerald's photo essay; Jenny makes a social faux pas.
An old ping-pong table rekindles a rivalry between Appa and Jung.
Appa's quest to retrieve his drill from Janet leads to an amorous encounter with Umma.
Following Appa's spelling error, Umma becomes the store sign maker.
Appa and Umma search for an excuse to avoid vacationing with the Lees.
Kimchee gets conflicting dating advice from Jung and Shannon.
Appa gives Umma feedback on an annoying habit and promptly regrets it.
A small fender bender leads to a big argument between Appa and Umma.
Umma tries to find her missing wedding ring before Appa does.
Only the Mehtas, Janet and Gerald know thus far that Raj cancelled his wedding.
While Appa is reluctant to have a houseguest, Umma ends up having problems with their visitor.
Umma is mistaken for a server at a school event; Appa takes up math tutoring to prove his prowess.
Janet plans to get the Kim family together for their first family dinner in 15 years.
Janet considers a new tattoo. Jung and Shannon exchange five-week-iversary gifts.
Appa unwittingly becomes Jung's soccer coach. Umma insists that Janet learn to cook.
Appa eavesdrops on Gerald and Chelsea getting together to tell a lie to her parents.
Umma entrusts Jung to pick Appa up from the dentist, but things don't go as planned.
Umma reevaluates her role as a mother. Appa comes into money and tries to do a good thing with it.
Jung pursues a new career and tries to involve Janet; Shannon and Kimchee see a new side of Terence.
Jung shows Shannon his nurturing side. Chelsea and Gerald get in the way of Janet's summer plans.
Umma thinks she has found a murder weapon; Kimchee struggles to fit in with other regional managers.
Appa and Umma's plans for the future push Appa out of his comfort zone.
Appa reaps the benefits of Umma's accessible parking pass. Janet embraces a new ambition.
A new church member makes Umma feel cast aside; Appa becomes jealous of Janet's journaling.
Appa unknowingly ruins Gerald's baby blanket. Jung invites Kimchee for a weekend in California.
Umma and Appa try to fit in at an upscale tennis court; Shannon helps Omar.
Appa's nerves are tested when Nayoung arrives with a furry friend.
Appa finds marijuana in the house. Shannon throws a staff party that doesn't go as planned.
Appa and Kimchee enjoy an impromptu hangout together; Janet and Umma find an envelope of money.
Appa worries about Umma; Janet uses Jung to boost her reputation; Kimchee thinks about an old flame.
Appa makes a controversial call when umpiring pastor Nina's baseball game; Umma gets a sweater.
Kimchee's plan to impress the higher-ups backfires. Shannon inadvertently insults Umma's cooking.
Umma tries to set up Janet with their new mason. Shannon encourages Jung to give Appa a gift.
Janet and Appa take a first aid course. Umma worries her prayers cause more harm than good.
Jung gives Appa and Umma a business presentation for the store.
Mr. Kim offers a gay discount; Mrs. Kim tries to find a cool, Christian-Korean boyfriend for Janet.
Mr. Kim gets competitive with Janet over who is the better photographer.
Jung draws the wrong kind of attention from his boss when he gives Kimchee a Korean wedgie at work.
Mr. Kim is frustrated with Frank the repairman; Janet's cousin Nayoung visits.
Mr. Chin asks Mr. Kim to be his wingman on a date, which is fine until Mrs. Kim tags along.
Alan está convencido de que hay jade debajo de un pozo lleno de agua en su reclamo de Dinastía.
Robin trata de desafiar las leyes de la física con la construcción de una barraca gigantesca.
La mala suerte persigue a la tripulación de Jade City, y todos piensan soluciones distintas.
Después de una travesía difícil, Claudia y equipo de Robin llegan a la montaña Wolverine.
Robin y Alan comprueban si el jade extraído puede venderse en el mercado chino.
Claudia y su equipo hacen un llamamiento a Steve para que los ayude a salvar la temporada.
La temporada de Jade está a punto de terminar y parece que no van a alcanzar el objetivo.
Las heladas de invierno se están acercando y el equipo aún no ha dado con la veta de jade.
Las máquinas de Claudia y Robin comienzan a averiarse en el brutal trayecto hacia la mina.
La tripulación intenta cruzar ríos crecidos mientras marchan con sus máquinas hacia la mina.
Josh se queda varado en el largo sendero que conduce a la mina de Wolverine.
Guy y R2 luchan para conseguir cualquier gramo de jade y Alan les hace una propuesta.
Guy queda a cargo de Wolverine. Claudia y Robin establecen los objetivos de esta temporada.
Jay sufre un colapso que deja al descubierto las fallas de su preparación para emergencias.
Un arsenal de rocas sin valor impulsa a Claudia a considerar una nueva estrategia minera.
Alan lleva a un grupo de compradores a Jade City y el equipo de Claudia entra en pánico.
Josh corre el riesgo de perder 1 millón de dólares tratando de sacar su camión de un pozo.
El equipo encuentra la mejor roca de jade de la temporada, pero corre el riesgo de socavar su valor.
Justin, el hijo de Claudia, demuestra que tiene olfato para el jade.
Robin y Justin hacen una última búsqueda desesperada para ir a buscar rocas de jade.
Ciudad de Jade se ve amenazada cuando el tanque séptico retrocede hacia el agua potable.
La presión para el equipo aumenta: deben encontrar la pieza de jade antes del final de la temporada.
Con la roca más prometedora del año bajo las sierras de Wolverine, Josh y R2 chocan su camión.
El frío y la nieve ponen en peligro el intento del grupo por abandonar el campamento.
Claudia se ve obligada a conducir el camión de rocas mientras su equipo lucha por el sendero rocoso.
Los Bunce se esfuerzan para llegar a su campamento de jade en Wolverine.
Los Bunce montan un nuevo campamento minero con la esperanza de impresionar a sus socios.
La primera gran roca de la temporada se lleva al campamento y se coloca debajo de la sierra.
Justin se apresura a reclamar lo que le pertenece, luego de tropezar con un asombroso hallazgo.
Justin y el equipo se distraen intentando mover una gigantesca roca que podría valer una fortuna.
Después de discutir con sus socios de negocios, Claudia y Robin corren para reiniciar la minería.
El equipo se esfuerza por poner en marcha la cantera de jade de la dinastía.
Justin y Mike luchan entre sí tratando de demostrar sus métodos a los impacientes inversores.
Alan les da a Justin y Mike una dosis de realidad sobre el jade que están extrayendo.
Justin y Mike luchan para llegar a la "Gran Aleta", la única losa de jade de gran valor.
El invierno llega a Dynasty y la tripulación lucha por la mía hasta el último minuto posible.
Al financiar sola su temporada de minería y decidida a comenzar su búsqueda de jade un mes antes, Claudia se ve obligada a repensar su estrategia.
Robin sigue una corazonada sobre un nuevo sitio en un antiguo reclamo.
Guy lucha con la excavadora para exponer un hallazgo enorme.
La tripulación se enfrenta a una peligrosa recuperación en las orillas del río Turnagain.
Recortar un posible hallazgo de un millón de dólares queda en suspenso cuando falla un equipo antiguo.
El corte finalmente comienza en la lente de jade gigante en Dynasty, pero grandes fracturas cortan la lente.
Los aguaceros amenazan la seguridad de la tripulación y cierran la minería en el Pozo 3.
Cuando un importante comprador de jade no queda impresionado con la lente Pozo 3, Claudia se ve obligada a tomar una decisión difícil.
La carrera para preparar el campamento en Wolverine se convierte en una pesadilla.
El brutal viaje a una nueva mina separa a la familia y lleva a Josh al límite.
Claudia está ansiosa por comenzar a construir el nuevo sitio.
Los pequeños lujos en el campamento animan a un equipo descontento y los visitantes sorpresa aumentan las esperanzas de Claudia.
Gary y Josh no regresan de una búsqueda rutinaria de combustible y los núcleos de perforación ponen en duda la calidad de las lentes de jade en 2 Mile.
La tripulación finalmente logra un gran éxito, pero con el invierno acercándose, a Claudia le preocupa que el gran hallazgo haya llegado demasiado tarde.
Claudia está desesperada por comenzar a minar, pero las brutales condiciones del camino la hacen preguntarse si la tripulación logrará llegar a su reclamo.
Mientras Guy y Gary se apresuran a arreglar el camino destrozado hacia el reclamo, Claudia espera que un nuevo miembro de la tripulación sea el billete de la suerte.
La juerga de compras sorpresa de Robin estresa a Claudia cuando sus errores de compra retrasan la temporada minera.
Claudia intenta mantener la paz cuando Robin y su padre chocan, mientras el equipo lucha por solucionar un problema tras otro en su camión minero.
Gary y Josh están frustrados por una serie de crisis, mientras Claudia hace un anuncio impactante que descarrila los planes de Robin y provoca un conflicto entre la pareja.
Tensions boil over between Robin, Josh and Steve about how to mine and when Claudia steps in, things get downright explosive.
Plagados de problemas con los camiones, Robin y su equipo corren para hacer un suministro de combustible antes de que el equipo se agote.
Robin choca con Claudia y Josh por la calidad del jade que sale de su pozo, mientras que el intento de Larry de ayudar a llevar el barracón de la tripulación al campamento fracasa.
Claudia y su equipo están decididos a seguir minando a pesar de los incendios forestales que arden alrededor de su reclamo, hasta que las cosas empeoran y tienen que correr para salir.
Después de perder dos semanas de minería en los incendios forestales, Claudia y Robin corren el riesgo de regresar a Two Mile y apostar por la apertura de un nuevo pozo.
Claudia se estresa tratando de preparar su mejor jade para los compradores, mientras la moral de su equipo se pone a prueba mientras luchan contra el frío.
Claudia hace todo lo posible para intentar hacer una gran venta a los compradores de jade, mientras en la mina Guy y Gary luchan contra la primera tormenta de nieve de la temporada.
Claudia presiona a su equipo para que siga minando a pesar de las gélidas temperaturas y el deterioro de las condiciones de las carreteras.
La temporada de Claudia comienza con fuerza cuando recibe un pedido de jade por valor de 250 000 dólares.
Después de años de obtener la parte dura del trato con Scrappy Larry, Robin le hace una broma a su viejo amigo.
Bajo presión para cumplir con el ajustado plazo de su comprador, Robin y Josh chocan cuando se topan con interminables problemas.
Cuando una avería grave amenaza con cerrar la mina, Claudia y Robin toman la arriesgada decisión.
Josh evita por poco el desastre al entrar a la mina con una carga de combustible y Claudia queda devastada.
Claudia y Robin se apresuran a encontrar una segunda roca de jade antes de que su comprador abandone el trato.
Claudia recurre a su padre Steve en busca de ayuda cuando teme que la mayor venta de su carrera minera se le esté escapando de las manos.
La tensión surge entre Claudia, Robin y Josh mientras hacen un último intento por cerrar un trato con un comprador de Vietnam.
Mover una enorme losa de jade pone a prueba el antiguo equipo de la mina y la paciencia de Josh.
Arrastrar una roca de 20 toneladas por el peligroso camino para salir de la mina resulta demasiado para su viejo camión 6-Pack.
Robin descubre una enorme lente de jade en Two Mile, pero podría ser demasiado grande para que su pequeña operación la excave.
Cuando una extraña tormenta de nieve en agosto deja a Claudia y Robin varados en Two Mile, Gary y Garon intentan salvar el día conduciendo a través de la tormenta.
Robin toma una decisión difícil sobre su querido camión minero 6-Pack después de otra costosa avería.
Con el invierno acercándose, Claudia lleva a su exhausto equipo al límite, provocando que los ánimos se caldeen.
La nueva temporada minera está llena de sorpresas desagradables, pero un rescate improbable salva el día.
Harto de trabajar para su padre, Josh inicia su propio negocio de transporte por carretera con un semirremolque nuevo.
El camión del ejército muere en el brutal camino hacia la mina.

The year is 1348. Europe has fallen under the shadow of the Black Death. As the plague decimates all in its path, fear and superstition are rife.
A dysfunctional couple kidnap a 19-year-old criminal and force him into rehabilitation.
When 13-year-old Jake's grandfather dies, his family moves from Manhattan back into his father's Brooklyn home.
A hastily married couple quickly devolve into a life of affairs, meddling parents, and therapy.
It's been a decade since Ben (Duplass) and Andrew (Leonard) were the bad boys of their college campus. Ben has settled down and found a job, wife, and home.
Frank (Joel Murray) has had enough of the downward spiral of American culture. Divorced, recently fired, and possibly terminally ill, Frank feels he has nothing left to live for.
Veteran actor Andy Garcia steps into the director's chair for his first voyage into feature filmmaking with this heartfelt tribute to revolutionary, late-'50s-era Cuba featuring Dustin Hoffman.
A musician couple captures a sound not meant for human ears. Soon, a stranger knocks on their door and their reality begins to blur.
The very day he’s about to drive his family to a new life in the city, geologist Kristian Elkjord senses something wrong with the mountain that overlooks his scenic town.

Ana joins an army of girls engaged in a never-ending war. Ana trains as a sharpshooter and discovers newfound freedom and courage. Though she finds strength, she comes to realize that she’s not the killer they want her to be.
Four young siblings vow to stay together when their mother dies. But when a ghostly presence torments them and a lawyer threatens their pact, the four must stand together or be torn apart forever.
Determined to honor his father's scouting legacy an Assistant Scoutmaster convinces a group of kids to secretly ditch a slumber party in favor of a weekend scout trip.
Recently divorced, newly rich, and utterly miserable, Danny [Kevin Corrigan] would seem to be the perfect test subject for a definitive look at the relationship between money and happiness.
A newlywed couple's idyllic country-lake honeymoon descends into chaos.

Alice (Emily Beecham) has engineered a special flower that makes its owner happy. Against company policy, Alice takes one home to her son. As their plant grows, so does Alice's suspicion that her new creation may not be as harmless as they thought.
Stream critically acclaimed independent films, powerful documentaries, and world cinema with Magnolia Selects.
Kat Connors' (Shailene Woodley) glamorous but strange mother Eve vanishes. Kat is excited by her new freedom but disturbing facts surface and the mystery begins to haunt her.
Golden Globe® Winner for best foreign language film. Katja’s family is killed in a terrorist attack and her life falls apart. The killers are set free and Katja can do nothing else but seek justice.

When a young mother and true believer from a violent IRA family is captured by British spies, she is forced to betray everything she believes in for the sake of her son in this taut, high-stakes thriller.
The story of New Zealander Burt Munro, who spent years building a 1920 Indian motorcycle -- a bike which helped him set the land-speed world record at Utah's Bonneville Salt Flats in 1967.
It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee (newcomer Kitana Kiki Rodriguez) is back on the block.

Jaz is surprised to discover her horse has been personally delivered by Mischa.
Concerned that Jaz is getting caught up in Mischa's scheme, Grace threatens to report him to the officials.
Repercussions occur when, Ted Franklin, causes problems for Drovers Run and Tayler digs up gossip about him.
Grace discovers some of the new cattle have been stolen, Tayler poses as Ingrid's assistant after a mistake.
Ingrid's husband Paul is investigating the cattle theft, and Phil has planned a special evening for Moira.
After being shot, Ingrid's husband Paul is determined to get his wife and nobody will stand in his way.
Rehearsals are in full swing as Moira prepares to play the leading girl in Phil's musical.
Hit hard by the drought and facing a growing debt, the very future of Drovers Run is at stake.
With the land of Drovers Run on the line, Stevie musters all her determination to do the impossible.
Half-sisters Tess and Claire are reunited when they take over the family ranch after their father's death.
It's shearing time and one of the men arrives with a reputation as a killer.
Jealousies arise as Claire competes in the rodeo while Nick and Alex compete for Tess's attention.
Claire buys a pen of undernourished sheep from the stock sales, leaving Tess to question her judgment.
Tess's confidence is shaken after she falls from her horse.
Tess learns that Drovers Run is mired in debt and she confronts Claire.
Claire must pay off a debt to Harry Ryan, who has his eye on Drovers Run.
When Claire's new mare runs off with a wild stallion, Alex and Nick offer their help.
When Claire's new mare runs off with a wild stallion, Alex and Nick offer their help.
The hunt for a boar that is threatening the livestock disrupts life and throws Tess's skills into question.
Emotional and traumatic events of the past and present return to haunt the lives of the women of Drovers Run.
Meg struggles to cope with the reality of JodI’s coming of age.
Jealousies and family tensions between the Ryan brothers suddenly come to light.
Claire and Tess save a neighbour from a burning shed, but all is not as it seems.
Theft is on everyone’s mind and the women on Drover’s Run have their own style of justice.
When Claire attends a seminar on artificial insemination with Alex, she leaves Tess in charge of Drovers Run.
The sudden death of local farmer Max Martin alarms Harry prompting fears of his own mortality.
The girls are ready to celebrate with a night at the pub and a bit of Karaoke.
Claire is finding it difficult to come to terms with Tess's new found relationship with Alex.
When a good-looking itinerant Italian rescues Jodi from a rampant steer she falls hopelessly in love with him.
Tess believes she can discover the real reason behind everybody’s behaviour.
Tess is delighted when Simon and Briony, two old friends, show up for an unexpected visit.
Jodi is in the final stages of arranging a charity polo match.
Peter check on Claire's progress training the quarter horses, and their flirtation takes a new turn.
Tess and Alex's relationship is put to the test when a baby is abandoned on his doorstep.
Becky is thrown from her horse and injured when someone takes a shot at her.
It's a dry spell and the women are suffering shared baths, stained washing, and unflushed toilets.
Meg is thrown into turmoil when her first love, ex-husband Kevin (Jodi’s father) returns after 18 years.
Meg is faced with the decision to stay in the place she loves or to leave with the man she loves.
Claire and Peter's growing relationship is leaving Tess feeling more and more isolated from her sister.
Claire and Peter move closer to marriage when he presents her with a ruby pendant.
Claire's relationships are fragmented.
Claire is taking the loss of Peter and Tess badly.
Becky's troublesome older brother Mark returns, determined to drag Sean into his life of illegality.
Frank Da Costa, the new cop in town, has it in for Terry.
Doctors try to diagnose a mystery condition that has deformed a man's head.
An eight-year-old with a form of dwarfism visits a specialist for answers.
A man born with four legs finds out whether two can be surgically removed.
A man with a life-threatening face tumor must conquer his fear of surgery.
An eleven-year-old boy is 6-feet-9-inches tall and still growing.
A teenager with a scale-like skin condition is desperate for relief.
A woman who cries blood is desperate for a diagnosis.
A man attempts to have a large facial tumor removed with a risky surgery.
A baby born with eight limbs undergoes groundbreaking surgery.
A man has thousands of bubble-like growths covering every inch of his body.
A boy has legs that have become so large he is unable to move.
A teenager hiding a rare condition hopes surgery will lead to normal life.
A boy living with tissue-thin skin searches for a cure.
A woman who slept through the birth of her child hopes to find a diagnosis.
A boy is born with three arms and a family has six fingers on each hand.
A girl lives with ants in her head and a man has a 132-pound tumor.
A girl's rare disorder causes her eyes to fall out of her head.
A boy's giant foot keeps growing and a dwarf boy defies the odds.
Doctors work to separate a baby boy from his parasitic twin.
A boy is born with no eyes and brothers suffer from a rare bone condition.
The world's tiniest brothers find out if they'll ever be able to grow.
A man learns to use a dead man's hand and a teenager has a parasitic twin.
A woman's arm burns from the inside out.
A man with half a torso learns if his rare bone-eating disease is back.
A man with cold-like symptoms loses his limbs and lips.
A woman suffering from cyclical vomiting syndrome searches for a cure.
A man's maimed hand is sewn into his stomach to avoid amputation.
A boy with undeveloped legs walks on all fours.
Irish twins' muscles and flesh turn to bone.
A young boy lives with an agonizing skin condition.
A man's body blows up like a balloon after a diving accident.
A man is born with his heart outside his rib cage.
A man has surgery on a huge tumor, and a woman with a giant leg finds love.
A man with a crippling skin condition lives life on his own terms.
A man whose body is eating itself hopes surgery can save his life.
Parents of a 44-pound baby try to learn why their son can't stop eating.
A full-face transplant patient battles a second life-threatening challenge.
A mathematician born with severely deformed legs walks on all fours.
A woman hopes a tooth transplant in her eye will stop her from going blind.
A woman's face is slowly being destroyed by a tumor.
Doctors attempt to separate a pair of conjoined twins at the head.
Nick Vujicic was born without arms or legs and his life is about to change.

programmes.t: Born Schizophrenic: Jani and Bodhi's Journey
programmes.d: Jani and Boudi struggle after being diagnosed with schizophrenia.
A family struggles after their daughter is diagnosed with schizophrenia.
A man's nightmares begin intruding into his waking life.
A father with a terrible condition races against time to find a cure.
Conjoined twins Maria and Theresa were declared doomed when they were born.
Follow three sets of conjoined twins and their lives after separation.
Kendra and Maliyah Herrin were born attached at the abdomen and pelvis.

Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.
Three singing caballeros blaze a side-splitting trail across the western frontier!
Two con men bet on who can bilk $50,000 from a wealthy woman in this dirty, rotten comedy!
In their final screen roles, Clark Gable and Marilyn Monroe are at their luminous best in this piercing drama.
In this madcap farce, two Chicago musicians disguise themselves as women to avoid the mob.
Jack Lemmon and Shirley MacLaine are delightful in this tale of love and ambition.
Billy Wilder's bawdy, charming and romantic farce about a French policeman who falls in love with a prostitute
A TV cameraman is accidentally clobbered during a football game and is convinced to feign a serious injury.
An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval
A con man and a naïve hustler from Texas try to survive on the unforgiving streets of New York.
Boxer Jake La Motta's life is filled with violence both in out of the ring in this masterpiece.
Action-packed spy thriller about mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.
Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with a safecracker.
This riveting tale sees a British publisher and a Russian editor sucked into the dangerous world of espionage.
When murder victims are discovered in Russia's Gorky Park, detective William Hurt is on the case and finds himself in a web of political treachery.
Ernest Borgnine stars as a butcher who gives up on love -- until he meets an equally lonely school teacher.
A widowed nurse (Lucille Ball) and her EIGHT kids get together with a widower (Henry Fonda) and his TEN kids!
Cher, Winona Ryder, and Christina Ricci shine as an unpredictable mother and her two quirky daughters.
A superstitious widow is ready to remarry...until she falls in love with her fiancé's brother!

Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action-packed glimpse into a dystopian future in the year 2018 where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just a part of the game! John Houseman co-stars.
After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims…

Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems…or their own lives.

In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.
Three problem teens headed to jail...until a police captain offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene.
Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).
Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.

In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy (Joel Kinnaman) -- a loving husband, father and good cop -- is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.
A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.
Detective Jack Caine (Dolph Lundgren) thought he;d dealt with every kind of crime on earth, but someone "or something" is using human bodies to manufacture narcotics.
A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and tough cop Rita Rizzoli is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

Seventeen years after a woman is attacked by a barely glimpsed creature in a Mississippi swamp, her teenage son's beastly nature surfaces and he begins a reign of terror in this exciting story of a human-into monster transformation.
The family that slays together stays together when six young travelers find themselves at the mercy of the eccentric Ma, Pa and their "children."

Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its own�and is controlling him through telepathic messages!

To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

programmes.t: The Monster That Challenged The World
programmes.d: The beaches go from fun-filled swim-fests to horrifying slug-fests when gargantuan vampire snails threaten to suck the life out of all mankind!

programmes.t: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programmes.d: Panic is rampant in this acclaimed thriller about a band of space explorers who suddenly find themselves being hunted by a maniacal creature.

When a gang of alien-clowns land in a nearby area (in a ship shaped like a circus big-top), the cops are skeptical. But before long, there can be no doubt: Killer Klowns from Outer Space are here to turn the Earth's population into candy floss!
Unaware the entire citizenry has been replaced by aliens, a professor arrives in a Midwestern town looking for his ex-wife who vanished.

Under cover of darkness, while an unsuspecting city sleeps, an alien life form begins to sow the seeds of unspeakable terror. Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Leonard Nimoy, Veronica Cartwright & Jeff Goldblum star in this classic suspense thriller.
In this thrilling creature feature, a young boy’s life is turned upside-down when alien invaders intent on taking over the world land in his backyard!

Steve Railsback stars in this frightening journey into the unknown as a mission to investigate Halley's Comet discovers an alien craft whose seductive leader begins a terrifying campaign to drain the lifeforce of everyone she encounters!

Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!

Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) seeks to avenge the murder of his kin by Leatherface, Chop-Top, The Cook and Grandpa. With the help of a radio DJ he finds his way to their underground slaughter shop, where a battle of epic proportions will soon rage.
A young teenage werewolf (Bruckner) is torn between honoring her family's secret and her love for a man (Dancy).

Struggling actress Mary Steenburgen is offered the film role of a lifetime by the mysterious Roddy McDowall. But all is not as it seems and, as the pieces fall into place, her quest for stardom becomes a fight for survival in this twisty thriller.
When a nine-year-old boy sees the ghost of a girl being murdered, he bravely sets out to solve the crime, but the killer may be closer than he knows!

A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

An English scientist entertains a young American visitor, serving up tea, terror and a beautiful daughter who is soon torn between her father's evil ways and protecting the man she loves. Boris Karloff stars in this H.P. Lovecraft adaptation.

When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.
Karen Black, Oliver Reed and Bette Davis star in this chiller as a family is surrounded by an evil  presence that feeds on torture, fear and murder.
In this terrifying sequel, the spirits of the dead are still hell-bent on luring the Freeling's daughter to the other side, where lies only evil!
Nancy Allen, Tom Skerritt, Zelda Rubenstein and Heather O'Rourke star in this suspense-filled conclusion to the terrifying "Poltergeist" trilogy.

Newcomer Steve (James Marsden) is cautioned by Gavin Strick (Nick Stahl) about the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic, perfect students who rule the school. When Gavin turns into a "perfect" himself, Steve and Rachel Wagner (Katie Holmes) investigate.

This lavish, epic western retells the true story of Wyoming's infamous Johnson County War, a brutal, late 19th century conflict during which wealthy cattlemen, backed by the U.S. government, hired mercenaries to murder 125 immigrant settlers.
Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory – and a cunning woman – to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

Rod Cameron plays a Western explorer with a unique scheme--to open a new desert route by using camels as pack animals. His trek is imperiled by a phony law-avoiding doctor (John Ireland) and his woman (Joanne Dru), a search for water and attacking Indians.
Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.

In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!
Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun.

Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.

Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison…in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

Twenty years after an unforgivable act, a pioneer has amassed immense wealth and a thriving mining town. But the blind ambition and greed that drove him to succeed finally catch up to him with the unexpected arrival of three apparent strangers.

In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.
Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.
Ane Ibarzabal presenta "Pensiones guipuzcoanas", con Pensión Balerdi, Pensión Urola y Pensión Txingurri como participantes, y gana Pensión Balerdi.
En este episodio, Donal le mostrará cómo ampliar su repertorio de cocina sin carne y que estar sin carne no significa sin sabor.
Donal prepara comidas navideñas en minutos.
Kevin retrocede en el tiempo con este menú mientras prepara una terrina de pollo ahumado.
El hermoso puerto pesquero de Arthurstown en Co. Wexford se celebra esta semana.
Conor y Amy son una pareja joven que ha decidido echar raíces juntos renovando una antigua granja.

Receta: salteado de alubias, txipirones y setas. Plantacion de alubia pinta alavesa de Pedro Fernandez de la peña (Elburgo). Seccion ¿truco o reto?: distinguir varios tipos de setas. Receta "en un pis pas": taco kale con marinada rapida de pescado. Explotacion horticola de Yolanda Vicente en Pobes (cultiva kale o col rizada).

Kevin visita su alacena y prepara una deliciosa ensalada de paloma torcaz.
Kevin logra recolectar algunas vieiras frescas en el mar para su tarta de vieiras caramelizada.
Ane Ibarzabal presenta "Casas de película", con Casa Dreams and Friends, Palacio Horkasitas y Casa Artiñano Etxea como alojamientos participantes, y gana Artiñano Etxea.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr Sue Morter and Anat Baniel who are experts in energy methods which help us to live abundantly healthy lives. International speaker and Master of Bio-Energetic Theory, Dr. Sue Morter utilizes the embodiment of high-frequency energy patterns to activate full human potential. Anat Baniel, founder of Anat Baniel Method NeuroMovement, has developed a method, supported by brain science, that powerfully taps into our brain’s enormous potential for change and learning.

Known for his wise and compassionate leadership skills, Jim has held numerous executive positions in the corporate world, and is currently the CEO of Unity World Headquarters. He shares experiences of bosses who led by fear and how he gleaned that there must be a better way. He developed a leadership style of cooperation, rather than competition.
