Host Lisa Garr interviews Machiel Klerk, licensed mental health therapist and dream expert. He is the author of Dream Guidance – Connecting to the Soul Through Dream Incubation. He discusses five steps to easily build and nurture a relationship with your dreams through the conscious effort of dream incubation. He has travelled the world and studied many cultures and their healing traditions, specifically their dream technologies.

Celebrity hypnotist Tim Shurr helps you unlock happiness and shed anxiety. Shari tests her hypnotizability, and the story of a woman who took back her mental health by empowering women worldwide. Plus, live from Heartfulness headquarters in India.

1963 Playboy Icon and Cosby Survivor, Victoria Valentino, shares her journey of overcoming unimaginable circumstances leading her to activism and purpose. Plus, one man's heroic efforts to save a tiny, unconscious life, and fun street interviews from NYC.

3x GRAMMY winner, J. Ivy, shares his transformation from a shy kid to a spoken word powerhouse. J. Ivy performs. Plus, a story about a bus driver who made a first grader's day, street interviews from NYC, and Daaji discusses the soul's evolution.

Do you feel both captivated and exhausted by city life? Are the conveniences worth the chaos? In this episode of the Rooted in Wellness podcast, join me, Wade Lightheart, and Matt Gallant as we explore the challenges of maintaining balance in busy urban environments and the serene contrast of ashram life.
Have you wondered how to biohack your health as a woman? Taking control to live your best life is what we dive into in this episode with guest Aggie Lal.

If your mind feels foggy or unfocused, your food could be the missing piece. Mona unpacks how nutrition impacts your brain, mood, and energy—offering simple shifts to nourish your body and sharpen your mind from the inside out.

As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.
There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.
Suffering has deep social causes. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains how your physiology is impacted by stress and social determinants.

Bread is a branded product with an endless number of varieties and providers. But do we actually know what we eat every day? We meet small craft bakers who stand up for their quality and we meet CEOs who work on bread as an industrial mass product which becomes increasingly artificial. How can traditional bakery skills survive? And how will the future of bread look like?

The birth control pill changed history—but how does it really work? This episode explores how the pill suppresses ovulation, alters hormone rhythms, and impacts mood, libido, vaginal health, PCOS, and cancer risk. Learn progestin vs. progesterone, what to expect coming off, and how to discuss informed consent.

Stress can shut down libido by spiking cortisol and pushing your body into survival mode. This episode explains the HPA axis, how chronic stress disrupts sleep, mood, and metabolism, and why desire often reflects nervous system safety. Learn simple resets—breathwork, walking, co-regulation, and better sleep.

Testosterone isn’t just for men—it fuels women’s energy, muscle, mood, brain function, and libido. This episode unpacks why levels decline, signs of low T, testing basics, and HRT options (creams, gels, injections, pellets), plus risks, benefits, and natural ways to support healthy hormones.

Intimacy isn’t just penetration or orgasm. This episode redefines pleasure through connection, consent, kink wisdom, and communication. Explore novelty, neurodivergent desire, self-pleasure, and how chronic pain or disability can reshape—without ending—intimacy. It’s sex on your terms, not the movie script.
How one woman defied a terminal diagnosis through radical inner work, proving consciousness directs biology and healing begins when we remember our power.
Did you know being active in the gym could improve your activity in the bedroom? Everything you wanted to ask about sex but didn’t. Now you can on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.
A man gets terrible headaches right at the height of passion. And a woman won’t talk about her sexual desires. What should her partner do? All this and more on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr Jill Bolte Taylor, a Harvard-trained and published neuroanatomist. She shares with us the idea of cellular circuitry and how there are four distinct modules of cells that make up who we are, combining the thinking mind and the emotional side. She discusses her new book, Whole Brain Living: The Anatomy of Choice and the Four Characteristics that Drive Our Life.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned infectious diseases specialist, pediatrician, parenting expert, speaker, and educator who discusses his latest book No Regrets Parenting: Turning Long Days and Short Years into Cherished Moments with Your Kids. He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. James Greenblatt, a pioneer in the field of integrative medicine who has been treating patients with eating disorders for many decades. His nutritional approach to psychiatry is revolutionary and has helped patients worldwide. He is the author of seven books, including Answers to Anorexia and Finally Focused: The Breakthrough Natural Treatment Plan for ADHD.

Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.
Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.
Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

Today's lesson is a bit of a reality check, as we'll begin to question the current way we look at relationships, romantic or not. How we see ourselves and our relationship to God influences our view of our relationships with other people. Today we're going to examine that view from a place of love.

A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

In the following lesson, we'll discover how the ego mind influences both our way of thinking and our relationships. We'll also identify the unconscious barriers we've built that cause us to form these judgments and thoughts. That's where the problem is, and that's where the solution lies.

The focus of today's lecture is this: atonement. While we decided to act a certain way in the past based on our personality, we can now use this information to improve our current and future relationships.

To truly grasp the concept of forgiveness, we have to be willing to see past the person's mistakes. The benefit we get from being more forgiving isn't that other people are going to be more forgiving towards us, it's that it won't affect us when they aren't.
In this lesson, we'll discover the significance of holy relationships. After all, souls are brought together for the purpose of enlightenment.

The team, led by Anand, prepare for their motorcycle adventure to the four sacred peaks. The first practice ride is here in the birthplace of yoga, but it is not encouraging as monsoons are destroying roads and villages, Fred seems a liability and Ryan's seizures could be an issue.

Jen and Jeff’s dream is to save their marriage on this journey, but it’s clear they are in different mindsets from the beginning. We are reminded that Anand himself had a prophecy of death and his teachers and life adventures helped guide him to freedom. Heading towards Kedarnath, night’s darkness sets in and Ryan sees someone Flip over their handlebars…

Our first glimpse of the first peak, Kedarnath, the temple of death. Anand reminds us that What needs to die is part of the ego, fears, and comforts. Ken thinks people are riding recklessly, Mario takes his first spill, injuring his passenger Aizhan. Jeff ‘s comments further alienate Jen, but motivate her to rise up to greatness…

Emptiness and Power in the Gap. The stunning Tungnath Peak at 13,000 ft, the Feminine Temple above the Masculine. Ken goes from rational doubter to having an experience beyond understanding that relates to his deceased sister. Unfortunately, the experience is tainted by ignorance and the seemingly inspiring day is further marred when Anna has an accident…

A small-town sheriff (Nick Nolte) becomes unhinged, thanks in part to his abusive, alcoholic father (James Coburn).
A 30-ish, gay New Yorker (Steven Weber) swears off sex, then falls for an HIV-positive guy (Michael T. Weiss) he meets at the gym.
An evil archaeologist tries to exploit five pygmy dinosaurs that hatched in a family's basement.
Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.
A lumberjack helps a tribe of rain-forest elves protect their kingdom from an evil spirit and greedy clear-cutters.
A bank robber (Steve McQueen) and his wife (Ali MacGraw) cross a big shot (Ben Johnson) and are chased to the Mexican border.
A freight pilot (Dennis Hopper), his girlfriend (Debi Mazar) and an apprentice (Stephen Dorff) try to deliver cargo to Earth in 2197.
While on a desert excursion, a family encounters cultists who use human hands as sacrificial offerings to their god.
A teacher (Colin Firth), obsessed with soccer and a team that hasn't won a league cup in 18 years, begins a shaky relationship.
A former special-forces agent (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) finds himself embroiled in police corruption and accused of murder.
An offbeat Ohio teenager (Winona Ryder) eagerly awaits the return of a legendary wild one she figures is her mother.
U.S. criminals hijack a cruise ship with a gluttonous private eye (Jackie Chan) aboard who is seeking a magnate's missing daughter.
Filmmaker Richard Linklater uses a string of mostly amateur actors to show varieties of a type: the new bohemian.
An evil archaeologist tries to exploit five pygmy dinosaurs that hatched in a family's basement.
Ordered to live among his tenants in squalor, a New York slumlord (Joe Pesci) does so and sees the light.
A Hong Kong detective (Jackie Chan) teams with a police veteran (Kent Cheng) to rescue a wealthy businessman from kidnappers.
An evil corporation planning an inescapable global computer network hires a mentally impaired laborer (Matt Frewer) made into a genius by virtual reality.
A shy teenage outcast (Hugh O'Conor) uses his chemistry genius to poison his family and others in '60s England.
Miniature dinosaurs help a boy outwit a malevolent governess who wants to pack him off to a military boarding school.
An insurance executive (Linda Fiorentino) skips town with drug money and stops at nothing to get what she wants.
A creepy policeman (Ray Liotta) gets close to a Los Angeles couple (Kurt Russell, Madeleine Stowe) in order to drive them apart.

En Funza, Cundinamarca, más de 2000 personas fueron engañadas por una asociación que prometía viviendas. Desde estafas hasta terrenos inapropiados, el sueño de tener casa propia se convirtió en una amarga pesadilla de promesas rotas.

En Ibagué, mujeres atrapadas por decisiones estéticas arriesgadas enfrentan consecuencias devastadoras. En busca de justicia, las huellas de un pasado oculto salen a la luz, mientras el miedo y el dolor de las víctimas desafían el sistema.

Jhon Fredy y Miguel Ángel adoptaron una niña, pero el Colegio Americano de Bogotá los rechazó por ser una familia homoparental. Fabio Meneses y Xiomy Díaz sufrieron en terapias de conversión. Andrés Felipe Arboleda fue asesinado por discriminación en Caldas.

Un productor de Séptimo Día graba cómo en un bar en Bucaramanga se alquilan niños para mendicidad. Yiriam y Franklin, migrantes venezolanos, pierden a su hija menor tras dejarla al cuidado de Franyeli, quien es detenida por mendicidad ajena. La Policía y el ICBF intervienen en varios casos similares.

Giovanny Padilla, registrador en La Jagua de Ibirico, fue asesinado el 1 de enero de 2018 en Valledupar. Dos jóvenes, Emanuel Castro y Jesús Sánchez, lo torturaron para robarle. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados.
El asesinato del niño Luis Santiago en Chía (Cundinamarca).

En 2014, en Santana, Huila, Jorge Cangrejo fue secuestrado y baleado en la cabeza por sus captores, quienes lo enterraron creyéndolo muerto. Milagrosamente sobrevivió y se convirtió en aliado clave de las autoridades para identificar a los responsables. Dos victimarios permanecen detenidos, acusados de tentativa de homicidio, porte ilegal de armas y secuestro simple agravado, enfrentando hasta 40 años de prisión.

Arauca se conmociono con el triple homicidio cometido al parecer por Jairo Enrique Vargas Maldonado, de 44 años de edad, Secretario de un juzgado de Arauca, acusado de asesinar a su esposa y sus dos hijos de 6 y 14 años de edad.

En 2009, desaparece Lía Patricia Nasser, estudiante de derecho de 26 años en Barranquilla. Entre los sospechosos: un compañero de colegio, su novio y la exnovia de su esposo. Tras descartar la hipótesis inicial, la investigación llevó a la captura de Eduardo Osa, compañero universitario, cuya culpabilidad quedó demostrada. La necropsia reveló asfixia mecánica. Osa aceptó los cargos y fue condenado a 26 años por homicidio y ocultamiento de pruebas.

Deibis Mildred y Adolfo González formaron una familia y un negocio exitoso de confecciones en Riohacha. En 2008, Adolfo fue asesinado en su casa, un crimen inicialmente sin resolver. Tres años después, las sospechas recayeron sobre Deibis Mildred, señalada de planear el homicidio junto a un amante para cobrar un seguro de vida. Fue condenada a 40 años de cárcel como coautora del asesinato.

Olga Lucía Gaviria y su hija María Ángel fueron asesinadas en Medellín en 2010. El padrastro, Edilson de Jesús Taborda, fue condenado a 60 años por celos enfermizos tras pruebas forenses que lo vincularon al doble homicidio.
Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.
Mario está demandando a la psíquica del vecindario, Lydia, por $30,000 y la imposición negligente de angustia emocional después de prometer eliminar su maldición ... por una tarifa.

Ariana García, de 19 años, está demandando a sus padres por angustia emocional y abuso, alegando que la negativa de sus padres a reconocer y respetar su privacidad y sus límites emocionales la ha llevado a perder amigos, confianza y negocios lucrativos como influencer de viajes.

Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.

Hace 21 años, paramilitares asesinaron a 60 personas en la masacre de El Salado. Jairo Castillo, alias 'Pitirri', ex paramilitar y testigo clave, acusa a Enilce López, "La Gata", de participar en el crimen. Su testimonio ha enviado a varios a prisión, incluyendo revelaciones sobre el asesinato de la fiscal Yolanda Paternina. Hoy, exiliado en Canadá, Pitirri vive bajo amenazas de muerte por sus declaraciones.

Tres historias: Patricia Osorio busca justicia tras el suicidio de su hijo Daniel, quien denunció abuso sexual por parte de un cura antes de morir. Mujeres ciegas se convierten en examinadoras táctiles, usando su sentido del tacto para detectar cáncer de mama. Y un profesor francés de 90 años dona su fortuna a mujeres que dejaron la prostitución, encontrando un nuevo hogar junto a ellas.

La pandemia disparó la violencia intrafamiliar en Colombia, con 360 feminicidios en 2020. En respuesta, el psicólogo Raúl Suárez lidera escuelas de "nuevas masculinidades", inspiradas en el feminicidio de Maira Barahona en 2016. La iniciativa Bochica enseña a hombres crianza, tareas domésticas y masculinidades no violentas a través de talleres, buscando romper estereotipos de género desde la infancia.

La madre adolescente Casie está decidida a probar que Casey es el padre. ¿Dirk es el padre del bebé de Brooke? ¿Cuál de los hermanos es el padre del bebé de Miranda? Brandon niega ser el padre de los dos hijos de Me'Chelle, pero incluso su madre está del lado de Me'Chelle.

¿Probará Katrina, de 25 años, que Christopher, de 50 años, es el padre de su bebé y callará a su nueva novia, Suprina? ¿El padre del bebé de Sarah es Johnny o un hombre casado? Además, Robert niega ser padre de los bebés de dos mujeres.

Teneal y Richard cuentan historias diferentes, cada uno alegando que el otro no es apto para ser padre. La verdad se limitará a una prueba con el detector de mentiras, y los resultados serán impactantes.

Kathern dice que su matrimonio perfecto se desmoronó cuando su esposo Lance confesó haber besado a otra mujer, ¡pero cree que hay algo más! Luego, Justine cree que Dorian se ha acostado con su mejor amiga, Anayah, ¡pero Dorian lo niega!
Troy admite engañar a Kela con su amiga y duda si sigue haciéndolo. Michael niega ser el padre del hijo de la joven Nikki, quien dice haberlo omitido del acta para protegerlo.

Otro hombre puede frustrar los planes de Devin de tener una relación con una estudiante universitaria; Zhane descubre quién ha estado ocupando el tiempo de su novio; Emily y su hermano se enteran de que sus parejas se han vuelto demasiado cercanas.

Sarah confronta a su novio y a la mujer con la que se rumorea que tuvo una cita; Thomas profesa una conexión emocional con la novia de su amigo; Tootie le da malas noticias a su novio y a su entrometida hermana.
Tish encuentra malas noticias mientras husmea en el celular de su amiga; Kalia quiere al novio de Victoria; CJ culpa a su esposa por su infidelidad.

La novia de Nick descubre por qué él pasa tanto tiempo con su vecina; el novio de Osha tiene una aventura con su amiga; Brandi resiente el comportamiento imprudente de su novio después de todos los sacrificios que ha hecho para mantener su relación.
Una mujer quiere saber la verdad de su hermana y su novio; una mujer debe decidir entre dos hombres; una mujer se junta con el novio de su amiga.

Un hombre, múltiples crímenes. Jorge Ignacio Palma, condenado por el asesinato de tres mujeres y el intento de matar a otras seis, deja tras de sí un rastro de horror, preguntas sin respuesta y una madre que exige justicia y verdad.
Dos personas son estafadas por el Ejército Nacional al acudir a ellos con la cédula militar de sus familiares.

Un sospechoso de un suicidio se desliza en las sombras de la impunidas y envenena la vida de dos gemelas menores, cuyo destino final parece sellado por sus mismas manos. Un sistema judicial lento y desbordado permite que la tragedia se repita.
Durante la pandemia, hubo cuerpos identificados incorrectamente, lo que dejó a muchas familias inseguras.
Carolina, de 48 años y de nacionalidad venezolana, cuenta su experiencia en el modelaje webcam.

Los piques ilegales siguen causando muertes y accidentes graves, dejando víctimas inocentes. A pesar de no estar tipificados como delito, aumentan la inseguridad, lo que genera demandas por leyes más estrictas para frenar esta práctica peligrosa.

Varios compradores en Colombia enfrentan el incumplimiento de Constructores que no entregan sus viviendas. Tras años de espera, demandan por estafa y negligencia, mientras los proyectos siguen paralizados o en problemas legales.

Rubén Andrade desapareció el 12 de abril de 2020 en Bosa. Su cuerpo fue hallado 4 días después en Soacha. Su ex, Yendi Paola, confesó haberlo envenenado y apuñalado, luego arrojó el cuerpo al río con ayuda de un taxista.

En 2013, Bryan Steven Rivera, un niño de 7 años, desapareció en la zona cafetera de Colombia; una testigo relató que un hombre lo atrajo con dulces. La investigación llevó a un retrato hablado de "El Peruano", identificado como Carlos Alberto Gómez Loaiza, con antecedentes por abuso sexual violento. Reconocido por testigos, fue detenido en Pereira para responder por la desaparición del menor.

Ángela Carolina fue hallada muerta en Villa Rica, Tolima. John Fredy, movido por odio hacia su esposa infiel, confesó el crimen y fue condenado a 36 años por el asesinato de Carolina y su esposa. Luego intentó cambiar su versión, sin éxito.

En 2015, en Arboledas, Norte de Santander, Cecilio Villamizar, el "Monstruo de Castro", abusó sexualmente de su hija de 13 años y asesinó a su hermano cuando este le pidió entregarse. Meses después mató también a su tío por temor a ser delatado. Finalmente, la menor rompió su silencio y denunció los abusos ante la Fiscalía. Villamizar fue condenado a 27 años de prisión por acceso carnal violento, acto sexual abusivo y homicidio agravado.
Cindy Piña fue asesinada por su ex Edinson Dussán en abril de 2020 en Neiva, tras visitarlo para ver a sus hijos. Estaba embarazada de su nueva pareja. Él la enterró en el patio y confesó.

Dos mujeres en Popayán, toman la decisión equivocada de invitar dos hombres a su casa para tomarse unos tragos, estos se drogan, se emborrachan y deciden que van a matarlas, en seguida los hombres huyen creyendo que habían asesinado a las dos mujeres, con lo que no contaban los atacantes, era que una de las víctimas sobreviviera y fuera testigo de los hechos.
Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.

Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.
Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.

Cuatro policías colombianos se infiltraron en África occidental, haciéndose pasar por turistas, profesores y médicos, para rescatar a la hermana Gloria Narváez, secuestrada por Al Qaeda en Malí durante cuatro años. El Coronel Gustavo Camargo lideró esta misión casi suicida, negociando en las entrañas del grupo terrorista. Tras años de estrategia y paciencia, la monja fue liberada sin disparos ni violencia.

En 2021, miles de migrantes haitianos, venezolanos y cubanos cruzaron el peligroso Tapón del Darién hacia Estados Unidos. Los Informantes siguió a Mikabens Meneus y su familia, quienes tras varados un mes en Necoclí, pagaron miles de dólares para atravesar la selva, enfrentando coyotes, pandillas y condiciones infrahumanas en busca del sueño americano.

¡Brittany cree que Dionte es el padre de su bebé y lo demostrará! Después, Melissa, de 24 años, afirma que Rob, de 47 años, es el padre de su bebé, ¡pero la hija de Rob quiere pruebas! Además, ¿el padre del bebé de Crystal es su ex, el primo de su ex, o su marido?

¡Regina afirma que Fernando es el padre de su hijo, pero su madre lo niega! Su familia lo apoya, aunque él fue asesinado. Mientras tanto, Krystal y Ben discuten su relación y quién es el padre de la hija de Krystal.

programmes.t: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
programmes.d: Mandy Lane, a Texas high-school beauty, is invited by her classmates to a weekend getaway at a secluded ranch.
By day, Abby Russell is a dedicated nurse, but by night, she lures cheating men to their brutal deaths.
A small suburban neighborhood is stricken with a mysterious parasitic virus.
A zombie and an uninfected girl form an unlikely relationship.
Jay becomes trapped by a vicious curse, and the only way to save herself is to put others in harm's way.
Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.
A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.
Hoss befriends Charlie Trent, a man who went from top Army scout to town drunk after he led his troops into a massacre.
A wild stallion is menacing all the local ranches and frees the horses.
Jim must sell some horses or lose the ranch, but he refuses to sell Fury, leading Piggott to trick him onto free government land with the horse, allowing Piggott to claim the stallion.
Joey and Pete go hunting, but what they find is trouble when an escaped criminal crosses their path.
During a drought, Joey becomes a junior ranger and tries to protect a couple of hunters from starting a forest fire.
Fury keeps running off to be with a white mare; Joey gets in trouble when he tries to solve the relationship.
Fury is missing.

Jana and Larry were renovating when a crisis moved them back in with mom & dad. Now they're ready to move on.
Crashing at the in-laws and living with zero privacy, Wyatt and Whitney are desperate to buy their own home.
Danny and Lashawnda love their space, but their kids' schedules and his three-hour commute are too much.
Busy parents Krystal and Cam are eager to swap their high-maintenance century home for a turnkey property.
Managing busy lives and twin babies in a cramped condo, Sarah and Scott are desperate for more space.
A couple bought their current home at a great low price intending to spend their savings on repairs.
Single mom Lolita is desperate to find a larger property for herself and her four growing boys.
Though Olivia and Dan's desperate for a fresh new start, their current fixer-upper is holding them back.
After years of studying, nurse Shannon and doctor Darl are ready for a real estate graduation.
Beth and Chris thought they'd found their forever home, but things have changed.
With an empty nest and a new lease on life, Sandy is looking to live it up in an urban pad of her own.
Delecia and Dwayne are desperate to buy a home for their growing family.
Nathan and Natalia recently moved, and though they're giving their new city a chance, Natalia's homesick.
Matt and Aleya want to find - and renovate - their dream home all in time for their upcoming dream wedding.
Danielle and Steve are now ready to move to a sprawling house even further from the city.
Crammed in their tiny condo, Katherine and Jordan are desperate to buy their first house and spread out.
Confined to a tiny home in a hot neighbourhood, Katie and Michael quickly sold their property.
Mom and Dad have been struggling with a poorly designed kitchen and a basement that's become a DIY-disaster.
Carlie and Drum are ready to expand their family, but their tiny urban condo is holding them back.
Jonie didn't hesitate when her eldest daughter Taisha asked to move back in with her own young daughter.
Tyler and Lindsay love their waterfront lifestyle, but their tiny condo is giving them the squeeze.
Suburbanites John and Christine are hoping to buy a new home in the city.
With their two small children Melissa and Joe outgrew the family home, so they moved in with her parents.
Tired of living in a rental apartment, attorney Gina is ready for a home where she can entertain in style.
With two growing daughters and a jam-packed home, Lori and Michael are drowning in clutter.
Done living in his parents' basement, newlyweds Stephanie and David are on the hunt for their forever home.
After years of living out of a suitcase it's time for globetrotting Aussies Levi and Alysha to put down roots.
It’s a typically crazy day at St. Mary’s when an Amber Alert rings out.

With Jackie's drug hookup crushed under a truck, she's run out of pills and is jonesing.
The Peytons meet with Grace's psychiatrist. When Jackie asks Eddie if he can fill Grace's scrip, he's cagey.
Kevin dodges Jackie early in the morning and takes off to batting practice where he meets Eddie.
Akalitus is all over the staff:  HR has mandated a urine sample from all the nurses.
It's business as usual, except the hospital has been purchased by the multinational corporation Quantum Bay.
Jackie is detoxing in rehab. When she wakes, she meets her elderly roommate, an unfriendly klepto named Doris.
Worried about Grace, Jackie leaves rehab early against the medical advice of her counselor.
When Grace reveals she knows about rehab, Jackie is blindsided, and goes to Kevin's.
Jackie, making pancakes for the girls, realizes too late that the girls aren't even home.
Jackie and Zoey grow accustomed to their new living situation at the Peyton home, and “co-parenting” duties.
Jackie meets her divorce lawyer, and is told to play hardball with Kevin if she wants to keep her kids.
Hospitals are no stranger to the things that keep us up at night or the secrets we keep.
A marquee plastic surgery at St Mary’s hospital may change a little girl’s life.
A tragic accident at a concert suddenly puts St Mary’s in a Code Orange.
Ghosts from the past make a day at St Mary’s especially trying for our nurses.
It’s Nursing Week and St Mary’s nurses are confronted by the fact that everyone has a hidden side.
Nurses always aim to be healers, so it’s hard to accept that sometimes things get worse before they get better
With a pandemic on the horizon, our nurses each deal with people longing for wishes to come true.
The St. Mary's nursing team must confront their first confirmed case of the Coronavirus.

programmes.d: Racing America 24/7 presents special live coverage of the Superkarts! USA Supernationals 29 from Las Vegas Motor Speedway.
A revelation about the owner of the uniform shakes So Jin's faith in her DNA experiments.
Yeon Woo breaks up with So Jin, prompting Kang Hoon to finally confess his feelings.
So Jin realizes Kang Hoon is her true DNA Lover, but facing Yeon Woo remains painful.
So Jin struggles with Kang Hoon's confession. As Yeon Woo plans to leave for the U.S., So Jin is abducted.
Yeon Woo and Kang Hoon race to rescue So Jin after uncovering the kidnapper's identity.
Yeon Woo leaves for the U.S. without saying goodbye, and the two unexpectedly reunite a year later.
Hong Deok Su and Prince Mu Yeong join Yongcheonru as apprentices, each with their own hidden motives.
Disguised as Lee Eun Ho, the prince keeps a close eye on Deok Su as he attempts to retrieve the golden key.
A murder involving a forged certificate raises tensions, while the quartet struggles to pass their exams.
Jun Hwa discovers Deok Su's secret by accident. Eun Ho and Deok Su develop subtle feelings for each other.
Deok Su risks exposing herself after an unexpected incident, but Eun Ho barges in.
Deok Su and Eun Ho share a room as part of their test, but their hearts are shaken by inexplicable emotions.
Eun Ho and Jun Hwa take action to save the imprisoned Deok Su, who believes Seol Mae Hwa is behind this.
Deok Su returns with a plan to reclaim her place at Yongcheonru and declares war on Seol Mae Hwa.
Deok Su's plan succeeds and receives the approval of Yongcheonru's owner, while Seol Mae Hwa is in distress.
Eun Ho is bothered by Deok Su and Jun Hwa's closeness. Deok Su's mother visits at Master Cheon's request.
Deok Su vows revenge against Master Cheon, while Eun Ho accepts an arranged engagement to further his plan.
Eun Ho and Deok Su clash over the golden keys but eventually make a pact to work together.
Eun Ho and Deok Su confirm their mutual feelings, and he vows to protect her, while Jun Hwa is heartbroken.
Deok Su is shocked by Eun Ho's royal identity. Now, the prince must confront those who are after the ledger.
Deok Su deceives Master Cheon to execute her revenge, but Jun Hwa obeys his father's orders to stop her.
Eun Ho reveals the ugly truth of the past to the world. A new era of kings begins.
Wang Won, the crown prince of the Goryeo Dynasty, visits Lee Seung Hyu with his friend Wang Rin.
As it gets dark, Wang Won and Wang Rin spend a night in a cave with Eun San.
Wang Jeon asks permission of Eun Yeong Baek, the father of Eun San, to marry her.
Wang Won tries to find the one who shot an arrow at King Chung Ryeol to prove Wang Rin's innocence.
Due to Song In's trick, Eun San is caught as one of the attackers of the King's assassination.
Song In gets to know Eun San's identity and forces her to marry Wang Jeon.
While Wang Rin tries hard to mar Eun San's marriage talks, Wang Won senses the uneasy atmosphere.
King Chung Ryeol becomes furious when he hears that Wang Won interfered in Wang Jeon's marriage.
Wang Rin puts up himself to save his sister Wang Dan.

Young writer Richard Collier is met on the opening night of his first play by an old lady who begs him to "Come back to me". Mystified, he tries to find out about her, and learns that she is a famous stage actress from the early twentieth century. Becoming more and more obsessed with her, by self-hypnosis he manages to travel back in timeâ€”where he meets her.
The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.

John Thornton, is a fearless man who's after more than gold; he wants to do what's right. Thornton works for the U.S. mail and is the only person daring and smart enough to figure out how to travel the deadly 600 miles from Skagway to Dawson, Alaska in the icy winter. His incredibly dog Buck is by his side and part of how he survives.
A scientist keeps his wife young by killing, stealing the bodies of, and taking the gland fluid from virgin brides.

The tranquility of a small town is marred only by sheriff Tod Shaw's unsuccessful courtship of widow Ellen Benson, a pacifist who can't abide guns and those who use them. But violence descends on Ellen's household willy-nilly when the U.S. President passes through town... and slightly psycho hired assassin John Baron finds the Benson home ideal for an ambush.

A scientific team in Mexico discover a pool of unusual baby "octopus-like" specimens. Gathering a few for analysis back at the lab, it is soon discovered that the critters belong to a gangly six-foot half man/half octopus-like creature, that's pretty angry and wants her 'babies' returnedâ€¦

Han Wu-song, an antique collector, gets killed while appraising a bronze horse rider statue which trader Wang Dae-in has stolen from a tomb. Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name

George Trent, a British spy, has gone incommunicado in Ibiza. Appleton Porter (Donald Sutherland) is sent to find out what happened to Trent. Porter settles into a small hotel with several busybody guests. He probes them for information about Trent, their former neighbor. Meanwhile, the spy survives several attempts on his life as he attempts to solve the mystery.

In postwar Vienna, Austria, Holly Martins, a writer of pulp Westerns, arrives penniless as a guest of his childhood chum Harry Lime, only to learn he has died. Martins develops a conspiracy theory after learning of a "third man" present at the time of Harry's death, running into interference from British officer Major Calloway, and falling head-over-heels for Harry's grief-stricken lover, Anna.

A young Dad suddenly suffers frightening seizures while driving his wife and baby. Aaron and Laura treat a serial daredevil with serious injuries after a spectacular crash on his dirt bike and Chris and Sam play “word of the day”.

Aaron is ready for anything as he resets a netballer’s shoulder, but is he prepared for the cheeky sportswoman’s banter? Chris teams up with Laura to help an elderly Parkinson’s patient with a growing infection that could turn septic.

A confronting case for Nhi and Carlos as they are called to a woman running in front of traffic. Dan helps a star footballer who’s busted his leg at training and new dad, Bill races to a baby in trouble.

A terrified patient with a failing heart has Aaron and Laura on high alert. Chris and Sam meet their oldest ever patient. 104-year-old Nelly has terrible face injuries after a fall but still gives the boys her secret to longevity.

Every second counts as Bill battles to save a woman with catastrophic head injuries after she fell four metres through a roof onto a concrete floor. Laura and Aaron rush to a mum found unconscious in her car.

A sudden collapse shocks Olivia and Sally as their patient suddenly appears to be having a heart attack. Carlos and Nhi fear for their safety as a volatile woman lashes out in the back of the ambulance.
A baby in a hurry could arrive before Bill gets the pregnant mother to hospital. Nhi and Carlos crash a birthday party after the guest of honour collapses in front of her terrified family.

Dr Emma faces a dangerous situation with an aggressive stabbing victim. The patient will die without help, yet he’s putting up a fight. Dr Mark treats a factory worker in shock after being confronted with horrific life-changing injuries.

A gunshot victim arrives under police guard and Dr Sarah fears the patient could die from his injuries. Dr Jonathan treats a critical footy player after an on-field collision. Nurse Lucy worries a pregnant patient can’t feel her baby move.

Dr Mark tries to help a car crash patient under police guard, but the man appears to be hiding something suspicious in his underpants. Dr Miriam examines a cheerful 82-year-old biker with fractures, who suddenly takes a turn for the worse.

Dr Mark assembles a crack team to save a man with life-threatening gunshot wounds. Dr Jonathan suspects a surf-coach has a shattered leg from a horror car crash, which could spell the end of the young man’s career.

Dr Emma’s patient could lose her fingers after a high-speed car crash. A gunshot victim has Dr Michael on high alert. Dr Michelle stitches up a young man who walked into a wall while checking his phone.

Security crash-tackles a violent man trying to smear blood onto hospital staff. Dr Jonathan’s car crash patient wasn’t wearing a seatbelt, but she’s more worried what her dad will say. Dr Mya’s scared patient has an unstoppable nosebleed.

Dr Steve’s young patient could lose his hand after a shocking accident at an abattoir. A severe asthmatic struggles to breathe, but Dr Bjorn suspects another trigger. A wayward spider sends a high-speed road crash victim to Dr Jana.

A life hangs in the balance as Dr Emma rushes to meet a critically injured road trauma victim at the helipad. Dr Lauren treats an American schoolboy who plunged 10 metres down a cliff and is bleeding heavily from an open fracture.

Dr Miriam treats a heavily pregnant mum-to-be who collapsed at a train station platform, falling face-first and landing on her stomach. Dr Sarah fears for a cyclist who was hit by a car and can’t feel his feet.

Mark and Carina race to help a critically injured paraglider who’s crashed into a cliff. A creepy case of bed bugs makes Michelle nervous. Jamie and Mike struggle to convince a cyclist hit by a car that she needs to go to hospital.

Mark and Carina race to save a young woman struggling to breathe from a severe asthma attack. Matt airlifts a trauma patient to hospital after a horror car crash. Taz and Amanda find a fun way of deciding who drives the ambulance.

Nat and Leonard get a surprise while treating a suspected drug overdose. A heartbreaking fall for a 98-year-old woman requires a delicate rescue mission. And vicious abuse from a member of the public shocks Amanda and Taz.

Nat and Leonard battle to save an elderly woman after a suspected stroke. Taz and Amanda race to help a child trapped in a car outside a kindergarten. A missing item of clothing has Nicola and Michelle scratching their heads.

Matt treats a patient burnt in a work-place explosion, but bad weather jeopardises the flight to hospital. Nat presses Leonard to propose marriage. Mark struggles with a misbehaving driver who’s crashed into a pole.

Mark is called to a volatile emergency as a man leaps from a moving car and goes on a rampage. Flight paramedic Ray races to a camping trip SOS. Amanda and Leonard treat a badly injured tourist after an ill-fated skateboarding attempt.

Every second counts as paramedics try to reach an unconscious patient by breaking into her house. Mark and Carina treat a man with a life-threatening condition, where the only way to save him is to stop his heart.

A mysterious young woman found unresponsive on a bus has Carina baffled. Matt becomes concerned after a frightened car crash survivor loses her memory. Risky and Nicola are confronted by an unwanted intruder.

Mark races to help a young father in danger of losing his arm, following a horrific workplace accident. After a car crash leaves a trail of destruction creating chaos, Nat and Leonard are shocked by a patient’s surprising revelation.

Royal Melbourne Emergency’s Dr Mya and Nurse Ebony brace themselves as paramedics bring in a man who’s been on a two-day drug bender. Dr Emma calls in back-up to save a mum who’s clinging to life after a high-speed crash.

In Royal Melbourne Emergency, a teen jockey has been crushed under a horse, fracturing her pelvis. This potentially career-ending injury isn’t Dr Mya Cubitt’s biggest worry. Dr Scott Taylor uses a clever hack for removing rings from swollen fingers.

At Royal Melbourne emergency, an abattoir worker has cut her fingers off. Can Dr Bjorn Makein and nurse Sarah Thomas save her hand? Dr Thomas Razga puts a young mum with an earring mishap on laughing gas, with hilarious results.

A crane operator is crushed under falling steel at work and is flown to The Royal Melbourne. Dr Jonathan Papson calls in reinforcements as the young worker’s vital signs worsen. Dr Emma West treats an erratic pregnant woman.

At Royal Melbourne Emergency a paramedic becomes the patient after stepping on a deadly snake while jogging. Drs Michael Dunne and Jana Alexander treat a seriously injured grandmother who was thrown off a horse and trampled.

In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Dr Sarah Whitelaw battles to save a teen driver with major head injuries after rolling his car. A trail bike rider crashes horribly, but impresses Dr Michelle Thornhill with his wit.

In Royal Melbourne Emergency, doctors rush to save a man bleeding internally after being thrown from a horse. A law student’s condition puzzles Dr Luke. Dr George has grave fears for a handy man who’s fallen six metres onto concrete.

In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Drs Michelle Thornhill and Martin Dutch have seconds to spare as a man struggles to breathe. Dr Jonathan Papson fixes up an old friend suffering severe bee stings from a backyard hive.

Every second counts at The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, as injured people pour in. Dr Luke treats an injured tradie hit by a falling tree. Later, he rejects a patient’s offer to mend a broken leg with icy pole sticks!

Australia’s paramedics fight to save lives in a race against time. Mike and Eamon treat the teenage victim of a brutal assault. Ray and the Air Ambulance crew help an unlucky gardener with a bizarre and dangerous injury.

A shocking motorcycle accident leaves a family man in critical condition. Can surgery in the back of an ambulance keep him alive? Cam races to help a baby arriving in a hurry. Amanda and Taz help a little patient who’s had a big fall.

Matt attempts a difficult rescue of an injured paraglider. A horse trainer is critical after being kicked in the head. An aggressive patient at a train station puts Taz and Amanda to the test. A hit and run endangers a baby’s life.

A mother is badly injured in a car crash and is desperate to find her baby girl. A shop assistant mysteriously collapses. Will expectant parents meet their baby in the back of the ambulance before Mike or Eamon can get them to hospital?

Carina and Doddsy battle traffic to save a child. Taz and Amanda have a hair-raising encounter with a dog bite victim. Cullen responds to a devastating road accident. Glenice takes a coastal trek to reach the victim of a selfie gone wrong

Can Cam’s detective skills crack a critical case? Nicola and Risky are baffled by a woman’s bizarre symptoms. A laid back patient with a major problem has Leonard and Amanda on tenterhooks and Ray helps the victim of a high-speed car crash.

Cam answers a dangerous callout to save a patient in crisis. What surprise does Amanda have in store to celebrate Taz’s ten years in the service? Mike and Eamon’s concerns grow for a newlywed couple who’ve come off their motorbike.

A bumpy ride for Amanda and Taz as they rush to a foster Mum in agony. Flight paramedic Matt races to help a student who is critically injured in a school sporting accident. Eamon works his charms on a distressed cyclist.
A gripping emergency airlift for a woman who’s suffered a massive stroke. A patient refuses to go to hospital without his beloved dog and a fun day at a waterpark turns into a nightmare.

Mike and Eamon treat a car accident victim who’s also been brutally stabbed. Nat and Leonard help a golfer who’s feeling sub-par. And Glenice meets a hero dog who raises the alarm when his owner is thrown from her horse.

Can Ray save the life of a farmer with a dangerously blocked heart? Cam earns the trust of a toddler in trouble. A volatile patient puts Amanda in the line of fire, and Leonard and Nat help a young Mum with a terrifying spider bite.

The final heat features only veterans, here for an opportunity to make up for their mistakes in the previous tournaments. Only one competitor will make it into the Grand Finals, and the others must suffer defeat, again.
After lengthy repairs and inspirational pep talks, the qualifiers prepare to fight for the title. A 10-way Robot Rumble will give the victor a spot in the Grand Finals, alongside the heat winners.

Competitors need to hold their own in this week’s trial, King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in centre of the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals?

House robot, Shunt goes head-to-head with the competitors. It’s his job to remove the competitors from the ring by any means necessary in this week’s trial, Sumo. Will Shunt do the house robots proud, or will the competitors give him the slip?

Even more barrels are stacked up, only to be knocked down by a competitor in another Pinball Warrior. After a one-sided fight, a unanimous decision from the judges decides the victor of this week’s heat finals.
This week’s special event has legs. The Walker Battle special featured robots that do not use wheels or tracks as locomotion battling it out, do they stand a chance against the house robots?

Half-way through the heats and Pinball Warrior returns to Robot Wars as another robot comes to test their aim and score against the house robots. The arena claims another robot as the knockout competitions march on.
The last robot football of The Third Wars in this week’s special. A spot in the final isn’t the only thing the heat final can offer one of the competitors this week.

The sixth Pinball warrior run introduces another competitor to test their skills against the targets, and the house robots. In the knockouts, the house robots are being exploited as the competitors over-crowd the CPZ zones.

We see more teams from around the UK bringing in their unique, sometimes amusing, sometimes terrifying robots to battle against each other. Sergeant Bash’s flamethrower is put to good use in the knockouts.
Walker Battle returns as the contestants for this week’s special prepare to put their best foot forward against the other legged robots. A competitor makes the house robots sweat in the knockouts.
Karma comes for one of the competitors as the Semi-Finals commence in spectacular fashion. There are no specials this week as the knockout battles take priority in deciding who will win the crown.
More heat winners are pitted against each other in knockout competition. The robots attempt to ram, flip and burn their way to the finals, all while trying to avoid the house robots.
This is what it’s been building up to, The Grand Final is here. Which of the successful semi-finalists will be crowned champion of Robot Wars: The Third Wars?

Initially released on VHS and broadcast on TV a year later, the World Championship featured sixteen robots from eleven different countries. A straight knockout competition would decide which robot would be known as the World Champion.

The wars begin yet again, competitors can only qualify by destroying or outsmarting their opponents, and doing their best to stay out of the house robots way. Sumo and Pinball Warrior will test the robots grit and accuracy.

Six competitors, including World Champion Razer battle it out for a shot at the Fourth Wars title. Irreparable damage could mean the permanent end of one of the veteran competitors in the semi-finals.

Rescue Robots face their toughest challenge yet as an Earthquake causes power cuts and landslides.

An unexploded bomb of unknown origin threatens the safety of Calamity City, the Rescue Robots have to dispose of it sor risk destroying the whole city.
Two research droids have gone missing whilst investigating bizarre volcanic activity. Will the Rescue Robots find them in time?

When another child goes missing, washed-up solicitor John Piggott unwittingly provides a catalyst for Detective Chief Superindent Maurice Jobson to start to right some wrongs.

From the director of Taken comes The Gunman, a pulse-pounding action thriller starring Sean Penn. It's been eight years since Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) worked as a black ops assassin and now someone from his old organization wants him dead. Pursued across Africa and Europe by elite hit men, Terrier is dragged back into his dangerous past as he engages in a relentless cat-and-mouse game to take out the man who betrayed him.

A few decades after the destruction of the Inca empire, a Spanish expedition leaves the mountains of Peru and goes down the Amazon river in search of gold and wealth. Soon, they come across great difficulties and Don Aguirres, a ruthless man who cares only about riches, becomes their leader. But will his quest lead them to "the golden city", or to certain destruction?

In the last days of WWII, Germany, desperate for any last grasp to defeat the allied powers, looked to their last remaining weapons and soldiers. The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland. Captain Hans Kessler (Lundgren) a grizzled submarine commander from both world wars, is called into service to help turn the tide of the war. The mission was soon to be known as Operation Seawolf.
A day in Austin unfolds through quirky encounters as aimless characters drift from one story to another.

programmes.t: The Gambler II: The Adventure Continues (Part 1)
programmes.d: Brady Hawkes, Billy Montana, and Jeremiah Hawkes are on a train bound for a huge gambling event when the train is taken over by a gang of vicious killers in search of money. As ransom, the gang takes young Jeremiah hostage. Brady and Billy embark on a quest to rescue him and form a small gang of their own along the way.

Dr. Lawrence Angelo (Pierce Brosnan) is a brilliant scientist obsessed with perfecting virtual reality software. When his experiments on animals fail, he finds the ideal substitute – Jobe Smith (Jeff Fahey), a slow-witted gardener. Dr. Angelo's goal is to benefit his human guinea pig and ultimately mankind itself, but evil lurks the guise of "the Shop," a shadowy group that seeks to use the technology to create an invincible war machine. A self-destructive punk rocker struggles with sobriety while trying to recapture the creative inspiration that led her band to success.

College drop-out Steve Jobs teams with childhood friend Steve “Woz” Wozniak to assemble the first Apple Computer in his parents’ garage. Driven by a relentless pursuit of excellence, Jobs transforms the world of computing at the cost of his personal life.
A sword-and-sorcery fantasy about a young man's search for revenge. Armed with supernatural powers, the handsome hero and his animal allies wage war against marauding forces.

Adapted from William Styron's best-selling novel, this passionate tale of a writer's love for a holocaust survivor is an exhilarating and compelling revelation. Screen favorite Meryl Streep received an Academy Award´ for her portrayal of Sophie Zawistowska in this penetrating drama set in post-World War II Brooklyn. Kevin Kline plays her all-consuming lover, Nathan.

A former street tough returns to his Philadelphia home after a stint in the military. Back on his home turf, he once again finds himself tangling with the mob boss who was instrumental in his going off to be a soldier.

Presiding over the renowned Battle Creek Sanitarium is the visionary cornflake inventor and health-craze huckster Dr. John Harvey Kellogg (Hopkins). Seeking to improve their health – and their marriage – are Eleanor (Fonda), Kellogg's spellbound devotee, and Will (Broderick), her reluctant but devoted husband. The guys have the opportunity to buy a replica of the '66 Batcycle; a collection of Marvel fan magazines from the '70s.
A young man wants to appraise his collection; Walt buys Wayne Gretzky memorabilia.
Jason Mewes invites the guys to a Renaissance fair; a customer brings in a valuable item.
Kevin Smith sends his daughter to The Stash to learn how to be a clerk; a customer wants to sell rare and unusual "Rocky" action figures.
A returning customer brings in a toy that Walt always coveted; an aspiring student brings in an autographed book.
Walt challenges the others to perform stand-up routines; a collector brings in Marvel Comics from the 1960s.
The guys agree to baby-sit a friend's daughter for the afternoon; an Indiana Jones superfan has items from the films.
Walt and the others attend BronyCon, a convention for "My Little Pony" fans; a customer wants to sell a Godzilla board game from the 1970s.
Walt considers buying the hand and footprints of Adam West and Burt Ward; a rare set of Star Wars comic strips.

Adam West visits and a race between the Batmobile and Black Beauty ensues; a customer sells the first appearance of Rocket Raccoon.
Artist Neal Adams and writer Denny O'Neil visit the Stash; the guys see a set of 50-year-old Batman night lights.
Butch Patrick (Eddie Munster) stops by the Stash; a never officially released rare Star Wars action figure.
Kevin's assistant, Ashley, learns about comic book retail at the Stash; pro wrestlers want to sell their comic.
Darryl McDaniels of Run-DMC brings his new comic to the Stash; the guys look at a Marvel Silver Age number one issue.
Billy Dee Williams stops by the store to win the Millennium Falcon the same way Lando lost it: a high-stakes card game.
Jason Mewes hangs out and plays clerk at the Stash; Walt wants to acquire a mysterious recreation of comic book art.
The guys attend a KISS concert; Walt lives out his childhood dream of meeting Gene Simmons; Ming considers buying an arcade cabinet.
Peter Mayhew ("Chewbacca") judges a Wookiee contest at the Stash; one of the hottest comic books of the 1990s.
Mike flies in the Batcopter to celebrate fifteen years at the Secret Stash; the guys look at one of the hottest books of the '90s.
Kevin talks comics with actor William Shatner; Walt covets a Mego doll that has unique packaging.
The guys and Bryan visit a "Jaws" museum; super-powered toilet paper comes through.
The guys are prompted to reconsider their preparations for the apocalypse by a zombie comic; an eccentric collector wants Walt's help.
Stan Lee helps a customer who is experiencing a comics crisis; a customer buys a classic issue of Fantastic Four.
Secret Stash employees audition with Walt and Bryan for a role in the claymation film they are making with Brian Quinn.
Comics artist, John Romita, Jr., draws an original piece for the Stash; Bryan shows interest in an Evel Knievel toy from his childhood.
Inspired by an old friend, the guys wear cowboy hats, and celebrate the old Wild West; a customer is searching for an iconic comic from the '80s.
Artist Jim Lee shares tales from the world of comics on the podcast; a comic book brings wedding bells to the Stash.
When Ming gets a selfie stick, he tries to go viral by filming the Stash; Walt examines bootleg toys of an '80s blockbuster.
Jason Mewes brings his infant daughter to the Stash to meet everyone; a customer sells comic book Slurpee cups.
Real-life superhero, Phoenix Jones, visits the store and patrols Red Bank with the guys; Walt reminisces about a Batman playset.
Walt and the boys go on a trip to cross off a bucket-list item; four key Spider-Man issues come to the Stash.
The Stash sponsors a blood drive at the shop with the help of horror queen Elvira; the boys discuss the joys of "Mystery Science Theater 3000."
When a vintage 1980s Pac-Man game lands on the counter, Ming prepares for battle; a rare Beatles board game excites the guys.
KITT from "Knight Rider" pulls up to the Stash; a rare Green Arrow Mego figure and Archie Bunker's grandson.
Lindsay Wagner ("The Bionic Woman") stops in for a Silver Surfer item; Jem and Ghostbusters toys spark another round of banter.
Ming and a customer joust over the price of Batman 111; Wolverine becomes the largest statue to ever enter the Stash.
Kevin and Harley visit for the Yoga Hosers premiere; Ming becomes a lead villain with help from a special-effects makeup legend.
Members of the 501st Legion of Stormtroopers invade the Stash looking for new recruits; the fate of a vintage Ewok playset.
Ralph Macchio seeks a rare "Karate Kid" playset; Ming gets an unforgettable lesson; Walt gets excited about a Mechagodzilla.
The guys prepare for a maritime adventure when the Batboat docks in Red Bank; Batman's first appearance.
Jason Mewes inserts himself into transactions involving a Deadshot statue and a vintage Death Star Space Station.
Actress Katrina Law ("Arrow") wants a copy of Batman 232; old school items involving Popeye, Dynomutt and Pogs.
Walt steps into the ring with a customer over an original Rock 'Em Sock 'Em Robots game; a rare piece of original Sal Buscema art.
Marky Ramone shares his artwork and bonds with Walt over robots; a King Kong item from 1975.
A Kreskin ESP game reveals Walt's powers of cognition; discussions about Mork from Ork and Dick Tracy's Rogues' Gallery.
Tom Cavanaugh visits the shop; Walt finds a Golden Age classic with "Human Torch No. 2."
Kevin Smith and the guys discuss how "The Walking Dead" started out as a comic book and became a cultural phenomenon.
Legendary horror icon Robert Englund, aka Freddy Krueger, personally delivers a birthday present to Ming.
The Stash & Red Bank cosplayers celebrate the centennial of Jack Kirby; one of the greatest innovators in comic book history.
Influential actor and rapper Method Man talks to the guys about his extensive comic book collection; "Starsky & Hutch" gear takes over The Stash.
Jay & Silent Bob cosplayers take over the streets of Red Bank; the Comic Book Men attempt to make history by setting a Guinness World Record.
Rare and interesting Star Wars items making their way into the Stash; Walt offers up big cash to try and score a beacon for the store.
Kevin Smith and the guys attend the premiere screening of a movie about themselves and the origination of the film "Clerks."
Actor Burt Ward, best known for portraying television's famous Robin the Boy Wonder, reminisces about his time on the set of "Batman" and judges the Stash's canine cosplay contest.
Walt meets his match during a heated negotiation with actor Mike Colter ("Luke Cage"); a "legendary" video game becomes both Walt's trash and Ming's treasure.
Troma Entertainment co-founder Lloyd Kaufman and his crew put the guys through a grueling audition to see if they have what it takes to be in a Troma film.
The boys take a field trip to the Pez Museum to determine if Walt is actually the owner of an extremely rare and valuable piece of Pez history.
When Walt learns that Ming befriended actor Michael Gray ("Shazam!"), he decides that he must meet the "Mighty Mortal."
Kevin and the boys attend the grand opening of Funko's new headquarters, where they get honored with their very own Pop! figures.
Walt challenges the staff to a flea market sales competition.
Kevin rallies the Stash for a game of street hockey; hurricane Mewes blows through the Stash, and no one is safe.
Walt wants the Stash to shoot its first commercial and to have Bryan direct it; one customer brings in a fanboy's dream.
Walt reluctantly lets Ming run a new sales promotion for the Stash based around zombies, but Ming's scary idea might be too frightening for Walt.
Walt and the guys take a road trip to an unexpected convention; the guys find a treasure in the trash; a customer brings in an item Mike wants for himself.
Ming dares Walt, Bryan and Mike to get tattoos; one customer looks for romance while another makes a deal.
Walt and the guys throw a birthday party at the Stash; larger-than-life Darth Vader helmet.
The guys attend a local auction; bad results from mixing comic books and cigars.
The guys pursue the Jersey Devil; selling Thundercat figures.
When Walt and Mike fall ill, Ming must run Stash by himself; first issues of Iron Man and Daredevil.
Ming arranges for the Stash to join in on the local sidewalk sale; Walt sells some early "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" comics.
Mike and Ming participate in a 5K zombie run for Kevin's charity; Walt buys an unusual item.
Kevin visits the Stash for a book signing; Jay acts as security; a customer brings in original artwork.
The guys prepare for a visit from Stan Lee; Walt has a chance to buy a valuable comic book.
The Stash sells an independent comic book, so the guys can see a costumed MMA fight; Walt buys nostalgic underwear.
The guys want to make a sandwich that represents the Stash; a valuable comic.
Walt negotiates for an original Asteroids arcade cabinet; Ming is excited for GI Joes.
The Stash holds an auction to help a friend sell his collection; relating to one of Spider-Man's enemies.
A customer tries to sell a gaming system with a twist; Ming buys another piece of his childhood.
The guys try to create their own comic book; Walt buys a signed issue of Creepy.
The guys play charades with a comic book twist; Walt has the chance to buy original artwork.
Ming plans a surprise for Walt's anniversary at The Stash; Ming learns the virtue of patience.
Lou Ferrigno gives Bryan a lesson on fitness; a customer wants to purchase a key comic by Frank Miller.
Walt and the guys are invited to an actual bat cave; a customer wants to sell his original Star Wars action figures.
The guys ask George Perez to help rebuild Mike's collection; vintage interactive comic books.
Ming has the chance to purchase an oversized toy from the '80s; taking a wife on the perfect date.
A fan sells a Mr. T backyard water game; Ming is inspired to have fun on a hot day; Walt risks the shop's street credibility.
The guys bid on derelict storage units in hopes of striking it rich; Walt finds a fellow Elfquest fanatic.
A fan of "The Dukes of Hazzard" stops by to show off his collection of memorabilia; Walt encounters his first "brony."
The guys travel to the Baltimore Comic Con to launch their comic book, "Cryptozoic Man"; Jeff works on a Saturday to fill in for Walt.

Owner Keiko emigrated from Japan to Vancouver where she opened a bakery featuring Kawaii menu items. Sadly her sweet dream turned to a nightmare and now Steve will have to help her back on the path to success.

In Italy, the culinary tradition of the egg is inextricably linked to pasta and pastries, in this episode Silvia explores 3 very different kinds of dishes all born of Italy's love of eggs. Including one of the most famous pasta recipes ever, Spaghetti Carbonara. A dish known the world over but seldom done right. Spoiler, it's all about the eggs and never, ever involves cream.

Let’s face it – when it comes to Italian food, carbs are king. Pizza, pasta, panini – it can feel impossible to enjoy Italian cuisine with a gluten-free lifestyle. But modern Italian home cooks have embraced gluten free culture and in this episode Silvia explores 3 very different ways of cooking Italian ‘Senza Gluten’!

Silvia starts with the basics. How do Italian home cooks shop for pantry staples and fresh produce? A guided visit to an Italian deli leads to shopping and preparing of: a rustic Tuscan chickpea pasta, bakes 2 succulent and savoury Schiacciata breads and Silvia's mothers Apple and Mascarpone cake. Proving that when an Italian pantry is well stocked you only need a few fresh ingredients to create simple yet memorable meals

Diana focuses on the foods of Southern India. Jacob Leung (chef and author) prepares ‘Red Onion Bhaji with Yoghurt Dipping Sauce,’ his favourite street food snack. Sarah Todd (chef) joins Diana to share her recipe for ‘Kerala Style Crispy Prawns,’ a dish she fell in love with while opening a restaurant in India. Diana creates a fragrant vegetarian dish ‘Tadka Dal.'

The series is off to an energetic start as Diana delves into the vibrant and healthy flavours of Vietnamese cooking. With the expertise of her flatmate Khanh Ong cooking their favorite dishes together. Diana is also joined in the kitchen by  chef Jerry Mai who demonstrates how to make mini rice pancakes that are best served with freshly brewed Vietnamese beer, of course!
Nothing beats the smell of fresh bread coming out of the oven and these rustic styles will have you running to the kitchen to bake.
Yay! Candy! A pastry kitchen can also include a confectionery, where candies are made. Here are some staples that every pastry chef learns to make.

Amanda volunteers to lead a company launch party. She partners with the seemingly arrogant Sam, but she's unaware that he is also the man she's been flirting with in an anonymous chatroom.

Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?
A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

On a trip to Scotland, an installation designer finds herself helping a small community create a festive light display, despite the interventions of a wealthy heir. Forced to work together, they unite to bring seasonal magic to light.

Mackenzie travels to Costa Rica for work. Her best friend Ethan comes along to get romantic inspiration for his action /adventure novel. Mackenzie has loved Ethan for a long time, but he only sees her as a friend--until a tourist named Lucas makes Ethan see Mackenzie in a new light.

After finding a spark with a woman on a train platform, a photographer posts a missed connection in the newspaper but never hears from her. Five years later, they meet again while on the way to the same wedding – hers.

What does it take to go from 2-wheel drive to 4-wheel drive? A new transfer case, front axle and transmission parts to name a few. Your not going to want miss this 4 wheel drive conversion today on Truck U.
Today on Truck U we’ll show you what it takes to pick out the right donor truck for your next project and give you an inside look at some of the problems areas inside the engine.
How do you get a truck to sell faster at a dealership? Bring it to Truck U and let them have their way with it. See if Matt and Bruno can flip this Ford on Truck U.
Matt and Bruno customize a truck for a local alligator hunter.
If you want to know what makes a low center of gravity so important on a Jeep, then you won’t want to miss this episode.
Our rock buggy chassis is ready for some major components, we’re going to bolt on some headers, cut holes for gauges, and even make mounts for a fuel cell.

Tony helps an owner move a custom Mercury to none other than Joe Zolper as a potential buyer. Then, a lead sends Tony to a dusty garage hiding a nearly untouched Porsche RS America with just 5,000 original miles.

State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.
