Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis!  Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get

This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a l

From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, li

General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it

Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geo

Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the mos

Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Scerif

Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.
A Hall of Famer?s search for an Exotic Car that fits; a blind man?s ?touchy feely? approach to seeing great cars.
Racing Legend Don Garlitts drops by the garage to get some help doing some upgrades to his Chrysler 300.
Willie and Kevin go through the steps it takes to make sure a car you are sending off with your child to college is reliable for years to come.
Willie and Kevin pull out all of the power on a modified C6 vette.
Willie brings a Mopar out of the stable to get a much needed suspension upgrade and the tranny.
Kevin and Willie B. put some personal touches on a Wildcat UTV.
Kevin and Willie get rid of the tired old leafspring and replace it with a monster torque arm suspension
The guys work on a new Challenger while reminiscing about the Mopars of old.
Willie works out the dent on a new custom hood.
The guys outfit a UTV Chase Truck to make sure their Race UTV can make it to the finish line.
Matt and Bruno work on a vintage C-10 with a few modern conveniences.
Don’t miss this episode of Truck U, when Matt and Bruno transform a modern Jeep LJ into a vintage Cj-8 scrambler.
See what it takes to rebuild a Turbo in a 7.3L Diesel on this episode of Truck U.

Like many projects, this 1954 Chevy 3100 restoration has stalled. So, we’re going to help this owner pickup the pieces on this project by installing a new 350 engine, completely overhaul the front end, and bolt-on new bumpers. After were done, this truck will be ready to get wired and fired.

Sometimes Bruno will do a favor for a fellow Race Car Driver friend. That’s why Top Fuel driver Clay Millican’s old Dodge Cummins is in the shop. Like everything Clay drives, this truck is tortured and has broke a few things. Matt and Bruno get to play pit today on Truck U.

Bruno and Matt have earned some vacation time, but before they get to take a break they need to finish work on the 2012 Toyota Tacoma 4wd. The guys transform a Toyota into a Expedition vehicle that can light up any path in its way.
It’s time for the ultimate axle reconstructive surgery.We install brand new Dana 44 axles on a 2008 Jeep Jk 4 wheel drive.
Fresh out of the paint shop, the guys install a whole new suspension and show off great new accessories for a 1969 Mustang.
Kevin hits the road to WeatherTech to find out what it takes to proudly display “Made in America.”
Kevin and Willie do what they can to correct the frame geometry of a ‘32 Ford while installing a new front-end assembly.
With a ‘08 EVO in the shop, the guys upgrade the cooling and show us what’s happening with that extra turbo pressure.

Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programmes.t: SPIN x Fire: Free Speech + Other Dirty Words
programmes.d: Hear Morello discuss his message and mission in Free Speech + Other Dirty Words, presented by SPIN and the FIRE, and hosted by Ryan Downey.

Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programmes.t: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programmes.d: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programmes.t: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programmes.d: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programmes.t: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programmes.d: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programmes.t: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programmes.d: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.
From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

Across seven rivers, through mountains and forests, 12 strongmen go to toughest places to find out who is strongest Viking in the World and open a new season of Strongman champions league for 2015. Events like the Hercules Hold, Yoke Race and pulling a real Viking ship are some of the ingredients of this fantastic show.

The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. Special implements like the biggest log in the world or the special Bavarian stone lift are not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for new personal, national and world records.
Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.

Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.
The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.
Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.
We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.
The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.
This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.
The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.
This stage is in Martinique and eight strongmen from all over the world will compete for the last chance to gather points before the world grand finals in December.
A special World championship under the newcomers and lightweights in the Strongman world. Some of them will step from this to the heavyweights divisions.

In the exciting Season 3 premiere, a new Alpha Pack arrives to wreak havoc on Scott's (Tyler Posey) life, while Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Isaac (Daniel Sharman) struggle to locate Erica (Gage Golightly) and Boyd (Sinqua Walls).

Allison and Lydia stumble on a clue to finding Boyd and Erica, while a childhood friend of Stiles goes missing. Meanwhile, Derek is surprised by the reappearance of someone from his past…someone he thought had died in the Hale house fire.

With Boyd (Sinqua Walls) and Cora (Adelaide Kane) on the loose and under the influence of the full moon, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) find that they may have to turn to an unlikely ally for help…Chris Argent (JR Bourne).

While Scott (Tyler Posey) tries to keep Isaac (Daniel Sharman) from engaging in a deadly confrontation with the Twins in school, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) attempts to prove his theory that the killings have absolutely nothing to do with werewolves.

During a bus ride to a cross country meet, Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends flash back to the events of a preemptive strike against the Alphas that has left several injured and possibly one or more dead.

Stranded at a motel in Fairvale, California for the night because of a postponed meet, Scott (Tyler Posey) and the others suffer strange experiences that cause them to believe members of their own group may the mysterious killer's newest targets.

As the danger begins to move closer to Scott (Tyler Posey) his trusted mentor and boss, Deaton (Seth Gilliam), is threatened. Meanwhile, Kali (Felisha Terrell) and the twins (Charlie Carver and Max Carver) go after Derek (Tyler Hoechlin).

Seeking answers, Scott (Tyler Posey). Allison (Crystal Reed) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) hear stories told by two unlikely narrators -- Peter (Ian Bohen) and Gerard (Michael Hogan) -- and discover a secret about the color of a werewolf's eyes.

As Allison (Crystal Reed) begins to suspect someone close to her may be involved in the murders, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) conclude that Lydia's (Holland Roden) rising talents may be their best bet to solving the murders.

Trapped inside an evacuated Beacon Hills hospital during a powerful storm, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) must defend themselves against the Alphas while trying to figure out how to save Cora's (Adelaide Kane) life.

With the threat growing more personal and time running out, Scott (Tyler Posey) is forced to make a difficult choice to save family and friends while, at the same time, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Peter (Ian Bohen) try to figure out how to save Cora.

In the mid-season finale, under Deaton's advice, Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends use an ancient but dangerous ritual to help them both save the lives of the people they love and stop Deucalion (Gideon Emery) from achieving his sinister goal.

Weeks after saving the lives of their parents, Scott, Stiles and Allison suffer strange side effects from their ritual sacrifice. At the same time, the newly enlightened Sheriff Stilinski scours through old cases, looking for supernatural causes.

Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends race to figure out how to catch the Werecoyote Malia before it's hunted down and killed by her father. Meanwhile, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Peter (Ian Bohen) are broken out of captivity by an unlikely ally.

On the night before Halloween, Mischief Night, a convicted murderer brought to Beacon Hills Hospital for surgery escapes, forcing Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends to step in to help when his unexpected target becomes clear.

With Beacon Hills under curfew due to the power outage, the teens decide to throw a black light Halloween party while Scott (Tyler Posey) tries to get Kira (Arden Cho) to trust him in the midst of an attack by a strange new threat.

Scott's friends pledge to protect him against an increasingly hostile enemy, while Argent, Isaac and Allison search the past for answers to the shadow creatures. At the same time, Stiles, fearing he is going insane, reaches out to Melissa for help.

After suffering from hallucinations for some time, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) mysteriously disappears one night and it's up to Scott (Tyler Posey) and the gang to figure out whether he has been kidnapped…and if the Oni had anything to do with it.

Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) mysteriously reappears, but is he himself? Meanwhile, Scott (Tyler Posey) must prevent a disaster and Lydia (Holland Roden) and Allison (Crystal Reed) seek help from an unlikely source...Peter Hale (Ian Bohen).

Stiles checks himself into a mental hospital named Echo House where he believes he will be safe from the Nogitsune. Will he be as far away from it as he thinks or closer than ever? Meanwhile Scott, Allison and Lydia look for a cure for him.

While Allison, Derek, Chris and Sheriff Stilinski try to track down Nogitsune, Kira's mother tells the story of the Nogitsune she came to know. Meanwhile, the Nogitsune has taken complete control of Stiles and manages to stay one step ahead.

With the Nogitsune still in control of their friend Stiles, Scott and Lydia find an unlikely ally in Peter Hale. Elsewhere, the effects of the Nogitsune have given Chris, Alison and Kira some trouble with four out-of-control werewolves.

Scott (Tyler Posey) and company race to rescue Lydia (Holland Roden) from the clutches of evil and get help from a young woman who has escaped from the metal hospital. But the Nogitsune makes a surprise move, resulting in a tragic loss to the group.

In the Season 4 finale, struck by disaster and nearly defeated, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) call on their friends and allies to make one last stand against the Nogitsune. And someone thought dead makes a surprising return.

Season 2 starts off with a recap of the first season.

Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn’t trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they’ve all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to “Double Helix”

A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.

In the world of 2055, men are extinct. Preserved by cryonics, a man (David Keith) awakens in Lithia, a poor matriarchy. He’s welcomed, but when he upsets the natural order of things, the question arises: Can the world men be revived? And should it?

When two archeologists (Lisa Zane, David Cubitt) discover a cocooned alien that suddenly begins to reanimate, the rest of the research team turns greedy, wanting to cash in on it. When the couple refuses, they find themselves numbered...or are they?

An alien (Rene Auberjonois) and his family live on a secure farm on Earth, where they grow their own food. Most of the aliens believe that the human race was wiped out in the war, but there is a group of humans in the woods...and they are starving!

A doctor (Maurice Godin) creates a controversial process to reverse aging and disease. So, when an older woman (Barbara Rush) he loves is close to death, he knows he can save her. But there is always a price to be paid...in The Outer Limits.

On Mars, the Free Alliance and the Coalition of Middle-Eastern and Pacific States mine minerals under a truce until an apparent attack on Earth. Without clear evidence of war, is retaliation wise, or hasty? Barbara Eve Harris and Adam Baldwin star.

A former soldier (Ron Perlman) has horrifying flashbacks from his days as a member of a covert branch of the military. But when flashback star to become reality, he wonders whether he is insane...or if there a new covert mission afoot.

Mac 27 (Nicolas Lea) is Innobotics' newest android. He’s emotionless, but he escapes after a glitch and takes a hostage, Celia (Nana Visitor). She sees human qualities in Mac and tries to convince him that he has feelings. But why help her captor?

Joe Pantoliano stars as a shock-jock whose specialty is ridiculing UFO believers. But when a true Believer sets himself on fire in front of Stan, the D.J. finds the very foundation of his disbelief beginning to crumble. Cynthia Nixon also stars.

When a cancer-ridden doctor (Robert Hayes) is given a full-body transplant, he soon develops disturbing visions of a life he never led, of loves he's never experienced... and of a shocking, brutal murder. Wendel Meldrum and Thomas Cavanaugh also star.

A brilliant inventor (Ralph Waite) who murdered a man who stole credit for his work, is double crossed by the other inmates in jail when they discover his "small friends" -- microscopic machines --can seve just about any purposeï¿½including jailbreak.

The Grell had come to earth not as equals, but as slaves. Now, an uprising has gripped the world in fear, and a high-ranking government official (Ted Shackelford), who is lost in Grell territory, experiences firsthand the ugly face of racism.

Dr. Eberhardt (Ralph Macchio) discovers a way for comatose patients to communicate with each other by interfacing with a computer. But when he hooks himself up to the machine, he discovers a cyberspace "paradise" he may never be able to leave!

Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

Karen Miller emprende un romance en un viaje por carretera con un hombre mayor, pero lo deja después de quedar embarazada y regresa a Arizona.
Los adolescentes Tamara y Leo se ven obligados a casarse cuando Tamara queda embarazada, pero la presión de criar una familia los separa.
El 23 de marzo de 1998, en el distrito 9 de Marsella, Sylvain Alloard, de 31 años, descubre al salir de su auto que tiene una rueda trasera pinchada.
En Saint-Andéol-Le-Château, Ródano, la Brigada de Investigación de Lyon investiga un cuádruple homicidio en el que una familia entera fue asesinada con la misma arma.
El cuerpo mutilado y sin vida de una mujer se encuentra en el bosque de Rambouillet.
Mientras la policía investigaba la desaparición de la adinerada viuda Olive Durand Deacon, a principios de 1949, no podrían haber imaginado la espantosa confesión.
El 5 de mayo de 1986, la pequeña Cécile Bloch, de 11 años, fue encontrada muerta en el sótano de su residencia en el distrito 19 de París.

A raíz de un escalofriante secuestro en Remoulins, los investigadores de Nimes, con la ayuda de importantes testimonios de testigos, se embarcaron en una implacable búsqueda de un conocido delincuente belga.
Xavier Flactif, su compañera Graziella y sus tres hijos desaparecen repentinamente.
El día antes de la coronación de la reina Isabel II, el cuerpo de una adolescente fue encontrado flotando en el río Támesis
El 25 de marzo de 2016, en Châteaumeillant (Cher), Gilles Tourny entra en la casa de Fernando Mourao, su vecino, y lo encuentra yaciendo en un charco de sangre.

En este episodio repasamos tres casos de chicas desaparecidas en Bizkaia y que generaron una gran intranquilidad en la sociedad vasca: Laura Orue (1999), Virginia Acebes (1999) y Aintzane Garay (2005).Un repaso a los hechos que marcaron a toda una comunidad.
Asesinato de Alicia, bebé de 17 meses, al ser lanzada por la ventana y de Gabriela, su madre, por parte de Daniel Montañez en Vitoria. Se repasan otros casos similares.

Krista Clark es una inadaptada social que ha sido rechazada toda su vida. Usa el sexo para ganar atención de los hombres y está convencida de que el verdadero amor será su boleto a una vida más feliz.
La madre soltera Laureen Blastow comienza a salir con su vecino Chris y sin darse cuenta entra en un ciclo de décadas de aterrador abuso.
Charlene Jackson detiene su carrera militar para casarse con Paul. Cuando descubre que a él le gustan los tríos con otras mujeres, ella huye y se despliega a Kuwait, enamorándose de otro soldado.
Después de un matrimonio fallido con un esposo infiel y una relación abusiva con un novio cruel, Liz Cahoon finalmente encuentra al hombre perfecto en Eric.
En mayo de 1978 serían asesinados en su domicilio de la calle Bellet de Palma de Mallorca Bernardo Oliver y Maria Moreta.
La noche del 22 de noviembre de 1964 un joven sueco regresó muy preocupado al apartamento del ibicenco barrio de Els Molins donde residía junto a su madre.
Después de dos relaciones fallidas, Michelle Covington es conquistada por un antiguo compañero de clase de la secundaria.
Una joven marcada por traumas de la infancia lucha por reconstruir su vida. Conoce al hombre de sus sueños, pero una vez comprometidos, la relación de la pareja se desmorona.
Donna, una madre soltera de cuatro hijos en la ciudad de Nueva York, es una trabajadora auxiliar de enfermería que desesperadamente quiere un esposo y una figura paterna para sus hijos.
Lori se sintió no amada y torpe durante su infancia.

Una joven hermosa pero desorientada se convierte en stripper y termina arruinando públicamente su reputación. El incidente conduce a una serie de malas relaciones hasta que una noche apuñala a su amante durante una pelea física y termina en la cárcel.
Nancy es una mujer con un historial de relaciones fallidas.
Martes, 11 de octubre de 2005. Eric Boisseranc regresa a su casa, en Chazay d'Azergues, un pequeño pueblo del Beaujolais.
El secuestro de Muriel Reigada desencadenó una búsqueda masiva por parte de la policía de Orleans, que duró 31 días y siete horas antes de que se identificaran a los culpables.
Marc Van Beers, un abogado fiscal de Bruselas de 36 años, muere en un accidente de tráfico durante su luna de miel.
Ruth Ellis fue la última mujer ahorcada en Gran Bretaña.
Primavera-verano de 1987. En cuestión de semanas, cuatro niñas son secuestradas y asesinadas en la región parisina.
Conocidos como los "Constructores del Horror", la desaparición de Jocelyne y Jean-Claude Saint Aubert conmocionó a su tranquilo barrio.
Marina Ciampi, de 52 años, es encontrada muerta en su casa de Marsella. La víctima está desnuda en su cama, con una bolsa de plástico en la cabeza.

En este episodio repasamos tres casos de chicas desaparecidas en Bizkaia y que generaron una gran intranquilidad en la sociedad vasca: Laura Orue (1999), Virginia Acebes (1999) y Aintzane Garay (2005).Un repaso a los hechos que marcaron a toda una comunidad.
Asesinato de Alicia, bebé de 17 meses, al ser lanzada por la ventana y de Gabriela, su madre, por parte de Daniel Montañez en Vitoria. Se repasan otros casos similares.
El caso de Yoni Palmier, denominado "el asesino en serie de Essonne", se desarrolló rápidamente bajo la atenta mirada de la policía de Versalles.

Año 1987. La aparición del cadáver de ciudadano alemán Winfred Brandt inicia una investigación que llevará a la resolución del misterioso caso de los restos humanos aparecidos en dos playas de la isla de Mallorca. Unas muertes relacionadas entre sí y que esconden múltiples incógnitas.
La LKA, la Oficina Estatal Alemana de Investigación Criminal, envía a Cenk Batu de incógnito como el oficial de relaciones con la prensa Sinan Afra para rastrear a un espía industrial.
Cenk Batu fue identificado como conductor de una red de traficantes de órganos.
Spoon se involucra más con Teri, lo que lleva a problemas personales y profesionales.
Mientras Hammer y Kelly realizan una misión secreta, Burner y Spoon se enfrentan a desafíos cuidando a la sobrina de Kelly, que aparentemente es formal y correcta.
Burner puede perder sus alas por causar un boom sónico mientras intentaba impresionar a dos mujeres. Además, Kate podría perder su bar cuando encuentran a una menor con una bebida.
Un piloto alemán presumido molesta a Burner, asusta a Spoon con su forma imprudente de conducir y conquista a Ice. Sin embargo, tiene un problema que podría dejarlo en tierra.
Hammer conoce a un joven interesante mientras juega billar en el 'Bucket'. Burner y Spoon son obligados a juzgar el concurso de Miss Pensacola.
Carla lleva fotos y mails de su hermana a Samuel, que lo asume como parte de su penitencia.
Samuel acusa a sus padres y a Javier de haberle cogido el album de Laura para evitarle sufrimiento.
Lorena confirma sus sospechas de que Celia sigue liada con Elias.
El ayuntamiento ha recibido una oferta de compra del mercado.
La inspectora jefe Miralles es la policía más veterana de la comisaría del Distrito Sur. La inspectora Alicia Ocaña se incorpora a la comisaría.
Los policias de distrito sur estan consternados por la violenta muerte del agente Hernandez.
Laura investiga a peticion de su madre la muerte de un amigo suyo, un influyente hombre de negocios. Aparentemente se trata de un infarto.
Laura recibe una invitacion para acudir a una mansion y resolver un enigma.
Has pasado 3 años desde que Víctor Ros acabará con Aldanza. La vida sonríe al inspector.
Ros y Blázquez se trasladan a Linares para investigar el robo del oro español.
En sus bodas de plata, el cadáver del ingeniero civil Sören Möller es encontrado en su coche de empresa calcinado.
Frank Loose, un antiguo armador, fue encontrado flotando sin vida en el mar Báltico. Lo habían golpeado por detrás y simplemente lo habían arrojado al agua.
En un lugar de demolición, Jan Steinert, un hombre sin hogar, observa a un hombre que huye de la policía y le esconde una bolsa de deporte verde.
La nueva misión de Cenk Batu le lleva directamente a los círculos islámicos.
La última misión de Batu lo lleva detrás de escena del mundo financiero.
Un exlíder de los Blue Angels está reclutando y le ofrece a Hammer un puesto en el equipo. También comienza un romance con Kate. Burner y Spoon intentan emparejar a Kate y Kelly.

La madre de Ice aparece sin avisar y organiza una cita con el coronel Kelly, sin saber que él es el oficial al mando de Ice. Una avioneta entra en el espacio aéreo militar y se estrella cuando Spoon vuela demasiado cerca de ella.

Swamp pierde confianza, tanto en su vuelo como en su intento de conquistar a Holly. Burner compite contra un nuevo instructor de Top Gun que no acepta perder, aunque los instructores deberían contenerse.
Un Nugget, volando como compañero, derriba a su líder en un combate simulado. Esto se llama "Blue on Blue". Dos mujeres buscan la atención de Spoon mientras dos pilotos persiguen a Ice.

Burner conoce y se enamora de una mujer con un secreto. Kelly y Hammer intentan obtener reconocimiento para un hombre suicida que se lanzó sobre una granada como marine, pero sobrevivió mientras las personas que intentó salvar murieron.
Adela descubre el gran secreto de Elias.
Celia va a confesar a Adela que la amante de Elias es ella, pero Adela ya lo sabe.
Elias convence a German para que ayude a que Jesus les deje paso y les ceda parte de la empresa.
Adela esta muy dolida con Elias por la revelacion de Celia.
Asuntos internos investiga a Miralles por el tiroteo en el que murio Jorge.
Alicia descubre que su madre queria divorciarse y decide pedir consejo a Miralles.
Laura continua atrapada en la mansion. Ya han muerto cuatro personas y ahora son Martin y Veronica, la hermana de laura, los que corren peligro.

In the premiere of It's A Beautiful World, Jeff Fuchs joins a team of doctors as they navigate the vast waterways of the Amazon River to deliver vital healthcare to remote Indigenous communities. Set in the tri-border region between Colombia, Brazil, and Peru, this episode offers a powerful look at medicine, resilience, and human connection in one of the most isolated places on Earth.

Jeff ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest to explore a secluded eco-lodge committed to sustainable living. He visits a monkey sanctuary working to rehabilitate rescued wildlife and ends the day by joining locals in a spirited community soccer tournament—celebrating the role of sport, conservation, and joy in jungle life.

Two years after his first Amazon expedition, Jeff Fuchs is invited back by his friend Juan Alan Muñoz for an extraordinary journey into one of the most remote and untouched parts of the rainforest. After arriving by cargo plane in the outpost of La Chorrera, Jeff boards Juan’s newly outfitted hospital boat—but before the journey can begin, he is summoned to meet the regional Chief of the Igara Paraná. In a powerful exchange of trust and tradition, Jeff offers gifts of maple syrup and receives th

With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving e

Before departing La Chorrera, Jeff takes time to explore Juan Alan Muñoz’s remarkable floating hospital—a lifeline for remote Amazonian communities. Onboard, Jeff witnesses eye surgeries, dental procedures, and vital health and nutrition services being delivered to those with no other access to medical care. As the boat prepares for its 400-mile journey, this episode offers an inspiring look at grassroots healthcare in one of the most inaccessible regions on Earth.

As the floating hospital leaves La Chorrera, Jeff arrives in the village of Providencia—home to the Bora people, whose culture is deeply tied to the sacred triad of coca, tobacco, and cassava. Unexpectedly, Jeff stumbles upon a rare and powerful event: a regional summit where Indigenous chiefs from across the Amazon have gathered to discuss peace, territory, and cultural preservation—an event many call the “G7 of the Amazon.” Following tradition, Jeff must await an invitation to meet the local c

Jeff is finally summoned to the Maloka—the ceremonial longhouse—by the Chief of the Bora people. In a moment of deep cultural significance, the Chief offers his blessing and invites Jeff to witness a traditional gathering of the entire village and visiting Amazonian leaders. As sacred dances unfold in rhythmic celebration, the air is filled with the earthy scent of Mambe being prepared—coca leaves ground and mixed in an ancestral ritual that binds community, history, and spirit. Throughout the journey, one sacred element has remained constant—Mambe, a traditional preparation of coca leaf that lies at the heart of Indigenous Amazonian life. In this episode, Jeff meets “Happy,” a spirited local who guides him through the complete Mambe-making process, from leaf to ritual. Through the voices of elders and community members, the episode explores the cultural, spiritual, and communal importance of Mambe—revealing its role not just as a sacred tradition, but as a living symbo

As Jeff’s journey along the Igara Paraná draws to a close, the hospital boat enters the Putumayo River—edging ever closer to the self-isolated Pupuna tribe. The first stop along this new stretch is Puerto Arica, a lively river town hosting an international soccer tournament that brings together traders, travelers, and communities from across the Amazon. Amid the weekend of celebration, Jeff is invited on a night-time caiman hunt beneath a moonlit sky, and joins a local tradesman for an early mor

While anchored for an overnight stay along the Putumayo River, Jeff and the crew are approached by a group of Israelites—members of a little-known, non-Indigenous community that has settled deep in the Amazon to prepare for a prophesied seven-year drought. What begins as a surreal encounter takes an unexpected turn when the group requests medical help for the ailing grandson of their community leader. This urgent plea grants Jeff and the team unprecedented access to a secretive world rarely seen

After weeks navigating remote rivers, dense jungle, and unexpected encounters, Jeff and the floating hospital team finally reach their most distant and mysterious destination: the territory of the self-isolated Pupuna. What follows is a delicate and respectful moment of contact, made possible only through trust built over years and the careful guidance of local leaders. Camila fiercely defends herself from Roberto's aggression and tells Max what happened. Mother Isabel, to help Camila, confides to Ezequiel why Roberto is extorting her. Max pressures Camila to tell him the whole truth.

Roberto confesses that he was the one who killed Gabriel to frame Camila. Camila cries with joy, knowing she is innocent of that death. Max reiterates his unconditional support, ratifying his great love for her. Ezequiel expresses his intention to marry Camila.

Ezequiel, rejected by Camila, manipulates her with a new job offer as assistant to his daughter Julia, all to try to get her closer to him. Max trusts in Camila's love. Torrealba asks them to join forces to find Rosa Blanco.

Faced with Ezequiel's intentions, Octavia and Marcelina verbally attack Camila. Max proposes and Camila hesitates but agrees to marry him. At a dinner party, Ezequiel gathers his children and Camila will be the special guest of honor.

At the dinner, the main topic will be Rosa Blanco. Ezequiel says that this woman was an opportunist who fell in love with and took advantage of his younger brother, Leoncio. Astrid offends by adding that she was a prostitute, guilty of the war between the two families because of her relationship with Augusto Aragón and also with Leoncio López.

Camila insists on knowing about her family relationship, she thinks she could be Max's cousin. Ezequiel wants to dispel the doubt that she could be his niece, he interrogates Mother Isabel who denies knowing it and also turns to Marcelina who confirms it. Camila protects Chantal, a girl who sells flowers.

Max and Camila in idyllic moments regardless of the outcome of the DNA. They continue their search for Rosa Blanco. Two parcels delivered by a messenger, one for the Lopez Mendez family and the other for the Aragon family, confirm the reappearance of El Doliente.
When they arrive at the house in El Jagüey, Mother Isabel does not let them enter, they meet Henry and presume that he may also be Rosa Blanco's son. Max thinks that something serious
Mother Isabel insists that Rosa Blanco will cause much harm to Camila. Little is known, only that through a phone call she assures that she will return to take revenge.

programmes.d: In this episode, we explain how to catch river walleyes in the early spring months. Also, we take a look at the operations conducted by the WI DNR in regards to the walleye population on the Menominee River with electro-fishing and tagging.

programmes.t: Stoked on Fishing - Bluefin Fishing on the El Dorado
programmes.d: Over the last few years, we have been hosting sponsored fishing charters on the El Dorad, out of Long Beach Sport Fishing. Due to Covid 19, the sport boats have new guidelines to follow and only offer limited guests. This turns out to be a massive benefit to the passengers because they have more space for Fishing. On this adventure, we fish on the El Dorado for the first time since the pandemic began and have a blast.

programmes.t: Stoked on Fishing - The Magdalena Bay Experience, Part Two
programmes.d: One of the best parts of traveling is the pleasant surprises that come along every trip. In last week's episode, Shea McIntee and the crew had a remarkable day of Marlin fishing in Madalena Bay. Now we find out Madalena Bay doesn't only have fantastic offshore fishing, it also has inshore fishing that is out of this world. Shea's captain takes us to some of his favorite spots to catch Red Snapper, Snook, Corbina, and a fish we have never seen before, Palometa.
Here's how to catch the biggest fish when the leaves start turning and the water cools down.
